mem/0001/1/p0: The first time I saw her, she was looking around for the classroom.
mem/0001/1/p1: Her face was full of anxiety, but her eyes held a strong will and sparkled brightly, which left a strong impression on me.
mem/0001/1/p2: With her glossy black hair, she looked as lovely as a fairy from the gods' world, so I wanted to call her "Fairy-san."
mem/0001/1/p3: If you asked me why I thought of that nickname, I can only say it just clicked. Yes... it felt very fateful.
mem/0001/1/p4: But when I suggested it later as her nickname, she was quite surprised. Still, her blushing and flustered appearance was cute.
mem/0001/1/p5: Although she was summoned to the Garden as a representative of humans, she seemed much more delicate and fragile than her title suggested, so I decided I would do my best to be of help to her.
mem/0001/1/p6: After that, we held the sports festival, and we grew even closer. Even today, we spend our break times together as a group.
mem/0001/1/p7: "Hey, hey, Fairy-san! Fairy-san! I want to learn so much more about you."
mem/0001/1/p9: When I spoke to her, she smiled gently and nodded.
mem/0001/1/p10: I think she wants to actively learn about humans.
mem/0001/1/p11: Of course, I plan to work hard so that we can graduate as soon as possible, but right now, I was simply curious about her.
mem/0001/1/p12: "Fairy-san, you came from the same place as Tsukitsuki, didn't you?"
mem/0001/1/p13: "Yes, that's right. In a country called Japan..."
mem/0001/1/p14: "Japan is a wonderful place! There must be many kind and lovely people there, just like Fairy-san. Tsukitsuki is beautiful, and although Taketake is a bit short-tempered, he's small and cute! Ah, I want to go there too."
mem/0001/1/p16: "Oh, right! Right! What do you think about the gods of Greek mythology instead? Like me, Uncle Hades, or Didi?"
mem/0001/1/p19: "Uh, um, is it okay if I ask you something, Apollon-san?"
mem/0001/1/p20: "Hmm? What is it? What is it? Don't hold back, tell me!"
mem/0001/1/p21: Suddenly, the Fairy lowered her eyes, hesitating as if she found it difficult to speak.
mem/0001/1/p22: What's wrong? She was blinking a lot and seemed uneasy. Her cheeks were slightly flushed.
mem/0001/1/p24: "Are you feeling unwell? Are you okay? Shall we go to the nurse's office?"
mem/0001/1/p26: "Agana Berea. For a questioning session, she doesn't give you a chance to answer."
mem/0001/1/p28: With that, Balder stepped between us.
mem/0001/1/p29: "And besides, you seem to be a little too close."
mem/0001/1/p30: When I checked my position after hearing that, I realized I had jumped over the desk and was being pulled toward her.
mem/0001/1/p31: "Ah, I didn't notice at all! Sorry, sorry!"
mem/0001/1/p32: I hastily pulled back and apologized with all my heart.
mem/0001/1/p33: "Humans have something called personal space, and it is said that women have a wider space than men. It seems one is not allowed to enter it unless they are close."
mem/0001/1/p34: Tsukito displayed some complex knowledge, but I was more struck by the phrase 'close' than the meaning of his words.
mem/0001/1/p35: "So, does that mean it's fine if we become friends?"
mem/0001/1/p37: "Alright, if that's decided, Fairy-san! I want to talk with you a lot, and become even closer!"
mem/0001/1/p38: Thinking about the happy days that were yet to come, I took her hand and shook it firmly.
mem/0002/2/p0: "Alright! Alright! I'll do my best today too!"
mem/0002/2/p1: I pumped myself up and opened the library doors.
mem/0002/2/p2: It was silent inside, and no one seemed to be there. The library in this school isn't used very often.
mem/0002/2/p3: I only run into Tsukito or Uncle Hades every now and then. Balder doesn't seem to come here much, except for student council activities.
mem/0002/2/p4: If I can understand humans even a little, she'll surely be happy...
mem/0002/2/p5: With that thought in mind, I find time to study about humans in the library.
mem/0002/2/p6: No one asked me to, but I want to know for myself. Besides, I can't just ignore the fact that I'm falling behind other gods.
mem/0002/2/p7: "It's no good to trouble Fairy-san, absolutely! Absolutely!"
mem/0002/2/p8: But the library's collection is so vast that studying alone leaves me unsure where to start.
mem/0002/2/p9: "I know! I'll try the method Balder taught me the other day."
mem/0002/2/p10: Recently, Balder has seemed interested in Japanese customs and has been teaching me various things.
mem/0002/2/p11: "...I think he said to chant 'Which one should I choose? As the gods say,' point at the thing I'm hesitating over, and decide on whatever I'm pointing at when I finish the spell."
mem/0002/2/p12: It feels a bit ticklish and strange for a god like me to chant 'As the gods say,' but since I'm hesitating, there's no helping it.
mem/0002/2/p13: I point at the bookshelf and chant the spell loudly, just as I was taught.
mem/0002/2/p14: "Whi-ch one shoul-d I choo-se? As the god-s say!"
mem/0002/2/p15: My finger happened to point at a bookshelf I hadn't checked yet.
mem/0002/2/p17: I walked over and read the titles on the spines.
mem/0002/2/p18: "'The Art of Persuasion That Convinces Even Gods'... Hmm, this looks worth a look. Definitely worth it!"
mem/0002/2/p19: I smoothly pulled the book from the shelf and hugged it to my chest.
mem/0002/2/p20: "'100 Ways to Make Even Cupid Run Barefoot in Midsummer Heat' Since it's named after Cupid, the god of love, this has to be reliable info... Alright, I'll read this one too."
mem/0002/2/p21: As my eyes shifted from the left side of the shelf to the right, I noticed a row of intriguing titles.
mem/0002/2/p22: Before I knew it, I was holding more books than I could carry in my arms.
mem/0002/2/p23: "What is this? I'm curious about all of them! So curious! This shelf is full of interesting books. Great job, Baldr, for showing me this method!"
mem/0002/2/p24: I wanted to pick more, but I couldn't read them all at once if I carried too many, so I moved to the desk for now.
mem/0002/2/p25: "Alright, let's get serious with my studies! The first book is..."
mem/0002/2/p26: "Winning the Heart of That Girl You're Curious About with Side Dishes"
mem/0002/2/p27: The cover featured a bento box that looked absolutely delicious.
mem/0002/2/p28: Yellow tamagoyaki (rolled omelet), meat cooked to perfection, and a side dish of sauteed green vegetables.
mem/0002/2/p29: In the center of the rice was a small, round red object.
mem/0002/2/p30: I wasn't sure what kind of food it was, but I thought it looked very beautiful.
mem/0002/2/p31: Looking at it made my stomach growl.
mem/0002/2/p32: When I was in my godly form, I didn't really have the concept of 'being hungry,' so it still feels like a novel experience to me.
mem/0002/2/p33: "Wow, my stomach has already been captured! I guess for humans, catching someone's stomach is the same as winning their heart, right?"
mem/0002/2/p34: True enough, if someone handed me a bento box at just the right moment when I was hungry, I wouldn't feel bad about it.
mem/0002/2/p35: As I turned the pages, colorful bento boxes filled with various side dishes appeared one after another.
mem/0002/2/p36: With every page I turned, my stomach played a cheerful little melody of growls.
mem/0002/2/p38: Among them, one object stood out so much that it held my gaze without letting go.
mem/0002/2/p40: It has a smooth, round head and eight legs that curve outward in a neat arc.
mem/0002/2/p41: As a bonus, it has big, round eyes that stare right at me.
mem/0002/2/p42: "How cute! You're too cute! I couldn't possibly eat you with those eyes looking at me like that."
mem/0002/2/p43: Inside those takoyaki sausages was a heart that tried to delight the eyes, not just fill the stomach.
mem/0002/2/p44: "This is art! It's a wonderful sculpture!!"
mem/0002/2/p45: Each one had a slightly different shape due to how it was grilled. Their indescribably charming forms captivated me.
mem/0002/2/p46: Learning about humans' meticulous care for their food made me happy to have deepened my understanding of them.
mem/0002/2/p47: "Hmm... Are there also crab sausages as a variation!?"
mem/0002/2/p48: After that, my self-study continued late into the night.
mem/0003/3/p0: As usual, the bell rang to signal lunchtime.
mem/0003/3/p2: Boring classes finally ended, and the time for freedom had arrived.
mem/0003/3/p3: I sat up and stretched widely. Human bodies are inconvenient; if you stay in the same posture too long, your body stiffens, which is such a hassle.
mem/0003/3/p4: "Dionysus, try to pay attention in class."
mem/0003/3/p5: As I stretched and turned around, Hades-san was standing behind me.
mem/0003/3/p6: "Ugh~ It's so sluggish, my body. Just existing normally is exhausting enough, and we had to stand through the morning assembly."
mem/0003/3/p8: The more excuses he made, the more grim Hades's expression became.
mem/0003/3/p9: It was only a slight twitch of his eyebrows, but it was clear he was quite exasperated.
mem/0003/3/p10: Well, that makes sense. He lives under the same conditions, so his reasoning is understandable.
mem/0003/3/p11: He probably doesn't like the idea of me getting off easy while he suffers.
mem/0003/3/p12: "Hey, hey! Uncle Hades, Dionysus! Let's eat together! I promise to prepare an absolutely delicious bento!"
mem/0003/3/p13: Apollon cheerfully barged in. Honestly, he has no sense of the mood, but it's a welcome distraction for me.
mem/0003/3/p14: "Fairy-san, why don't you join us too?"
mem/0003/3/p15: Apollon waved enthusiastically at her, who was standing a bit further away. Even without waving, his vibrant voice echoed throughout the classroom.
mem/0003/3/p18: "I'm fine with it too. I don't have any plans anyway."
mem/0003/3/p19: If I'm going to eat, it's definitely better to have a cute girl along for the company.
mem/0003/3/p20: Plus, even though we live together in the dorms, the three of us rarely do things together, so I thought this was a good opportunity.
mem/0003/3/p21: "Thank you, Dionysus! What about you, Uncle Hades?"
mem/0003/3/p24: Interrupting Hades's words, he said something completely different from what he was about to say.
mem/0003/3/p26: Hades's eyes widened at my words.
mem/0003/3/p29: "That's right. He usually eats alone, so he wasn't expecting an invitation and is surprised, it seems~"
mem/0003/3/p30: Hades is probably happy deep down, but he has a habit of keeping his distance from people due to various concerns.
mem/0003/3/p31: So I spoke up for him... but...
mem/0003/3/p32: "But Uncle doesn't look troubled...? He looks troubled to me."
mem/0003/3/p33: Apollon was peering at Hades's face with concern.
mem/0003/3/p35: The distance was as close as ever, and Hades looked even more unsure of what to do.
mem/0003/3/p36: "Really? Are you sure? Are you really? But it feels like you're forcing yourself... After all, you won't meet my eyes."
mem/0003/3/p38: He shifted his body slightly to avoid Apollon, but he couldn't withstand Apollon's momentum, and the distance only shrank.
mem/0003/3/p39: They're still as clumsy as ever.
mem/0003/3/p40: "Alright, alright, that's enough~. Hades, you should be more straightforward. No one here cares about bad luck, right~?"
mem/0003/3/p41: Of course, I enjoyed watching them, but since Kusanagi-san was also looking troubled, I decided to intervene.
mem/0003/3/p42: "...I never said no from the start."
mem/0003/3/p45: Seeing Apollon's sun-bright expression at those words, my heart felt at ease.
mem/0003/3/p46: "Yay! I'm so happy, really happy! Since it's decided, let's go to the student council room to get some food!"
mem/0003/3/p49: Even while grumbling, Hades seemed to be in a good mood.
mem/0003/3/p50: "It's not bad to do this once in a while, right~?"
mem/0003/3/p51: We exchanged glances and, following Apollon, we headed toward the classroom entrance.
mem/0004/4/p0: "Have you found a story you want to do?"
mem/0004/4/p1: We had come to the library to look for material for our cultural festival play.
mem/0004/4/p2: Once he saw that everyone had found a book they were interested in, he spoke to the group.
mem/0004/4/p3: The books spread out on the desks were quite varied.
mem/0004/4/p4: "Cinderella," "Romeo and Juliet," "Snow White," "The Little Mermaid," "Oedipus," "Momotaro," and "Urashima Taro."
mem/0004/4/p5: Some of the titles were unusual for a cultural festival, but the gods' choices weren't entirely wrong.
mem/0004/4/p6: "They look good, everyone. Now, let's each look at our stories and decide."
mem/0004/4/p7: Acting out a story that we had discussed and decided on ourselves.
mem/0004/4/p8: I felt that this process itself was more important for understanding humans than the performance itself.
mem/0004/4/p9: It's just like how deciding what to do at the actual festival is the hardest part.
mem/0004/4/p10: "Hey, hey, before that~. There's something I want to ask you~."
mem/0004/4/p12: I was a little pleased that Dionysus, who usually didn't get involved so actively, was asking me a question.
mem/0004/4/p13: "There's 'Momotaro' and 'Urashima Taro' here. Are they brothers? Their names are similar~. Which one is the older brother?"
mem/0004/4/p15: I was taken aback by the unexpected question.
mem/0004/4/p16: Dionysus was seriously comparing the books, trying hard to grasp the characteristics of the two.
mem/0004/4/p17: "Didi, you've noticed something good! But this is a very difficult problem. You can't judge people just by appearances."
mem/0004/4/p19: Thor held up a book in front of the two, pointing out the existence of a third Taro.
mem/0004/4/p20: "'Kin' means gold, so maybe he's the eldest son? Gold is a valuable metal."
mem/0004/4/p21: Balder offered a plausible theory, and everyone present sighed in exasperation.
mem/0004/4/p22: "But just because he's the eldest doesn't mean he's the best. In many fables around the world, the youngest child is often the most capable."
mem/0004/4/p23: "That's right," Hades said, and then silence fell.
mem/0004/4/p24: "...Uncle Hades, I think you're incredibly outstanding, Uncle!"
mem/0004/4/p25: I grabbed both of Hades' shoulders and spoke passionately, as if to encourage him.
mem/0004/4/p26: "Hey, stop shaking me so much. You don't need to act so strange."
mem/0004/4/p27: "Hey, hey, just like 'Taro,' there are lots of 'Hime' too, so is it okay to count them as sisters~?"
mem/0004/4/p28: Loki slammed a new book onto the desk with a thud, having found it from somewhere.
mem/0004/4/p29: "Hey, hey, Fairy-san. Is Japan a big family?"
mem/0004/4/p31: I feel I need to ask for his opinion, which I've deduced from the current materials, but I'm at a loss for how to explain it.
mem/0004/4/p32: "That's impossible. 'Taro' is just a common name."
mem/0004/4/p33: A god of Japanese mythology, as expected. It seems he has knowledge of Japanese stories.
mem/0004/4/p34: "It's a name often given to the eldest son."
mem/0004/4/p35: Tsukito adds details to his brother's words.
mem/0004/4/p36: "What about 'Hime'? Is that a name too? Or is it part of a name?"
mem/0004/4/p38: "'Snow White' and 'The Little Mermaid' are Western fairy tales, and in this context, 'princess' indicates their social rank."
mem/0004/4/p39: Satisfied with Tsukito's words, the gods gave a small nod.
mem/0004/4/p40: "So, shall we start discussing which play to perform?"
mem/0004/4/p41: I urged them to return to the main topic at a natural pause in the conversation...
mem/0004/4/p42: "Wait a minute! Please wait! Is Momotaro called that because he was born from a peach?"
mem/0004/4/p44: "But is he really human? Humans aren't born from peaches, are they? I think he's more of a divine being."
mem/0004/4/p46: Apollon flipped through the pages rapidly, studying the contents with intense focus.
mem/0004/4/p47: "Since we're holding the cultural festival to learn about humans and performing plays, I don't think acting as gods would fulfill our purpose."
mem/0004/4/p48: Apollon's passionate speech continued on and on.
mem/0004/4/p49: I ended up addressing the gods' various doubts and questions as we deliberated on the details for each title.
mem/0004/4/p50: With each question, I managed to provide the correct information, and we finally settled on performing 'Cinderella'.
mem/0005/5/p0: "Come, come, Fairy! Hurry up! I'm starving. I skipped breakfast just for this!"
mem/0005/5/p1: Apollon waited with sparkling eyes as I took my lunch out of my bag.
mem/0005/5/p2: "Please make sure you've eaten breakfast properly. I'll serve it now."
mem/0005/5/p3: It all started when Balder expressed a desire to eat 'onigiri' (rice balls) after reading about them in a book during student council meetings.
mem/0005/5/p4: The conversation between Balder and Apollon heated up, and it eventually came down to me making the onigiri, thinking it wouldn't be too much trouble.
mem/0005/5/p6: I took out the wrapped rice balls and opened the lunchbox lid. A faint, pleasant aroma of seaweed drifted up.
mem/0005/5/p8: In that instant, a white blur zipped past my eyes, and the row of onigiri disappeared one by one.
mem/0005/5/p10: I looked over to see Balder holding a total of four rice balls, two in each hand.
mem/0005/5/p11: "...Yes. That's probably grilled meat. You have a good nose."
mem/0005/5/p12: I had varied the wrapping style and shape of the seaweed so the fillings would be distinct, but on the surface, you couldn't tell what was inside.
mem/0005/5/p13: "Of course. Why would I mistake my beloved meat? Can I have all of these?"
mem/0005/5/p14: I wonder what it is about him that draws people in so much...
mem/0005/5/p15: "Go ahead, go ahead! Enjoy as much as you like! I have plenty more rice balls."
mem/0005/5/p16: "I don't care about the taste as long as I can eat it."
mem/0005/5/p17: With their permission, Balder happily began to eat the rice balls.
mem/0005/5/p18: "Now, let me continue the explanation. Besides the grilled meat, the fillings include umeboshi, okaka (dried bonito flakes), and tuna mayo."
mem/0005/5/p19: "Which one is the most popular? I think it's best to start with the most famous one."
mem/0005/5/p20: "In that case, maybe the umeboshi. But umeboshi has a strong, acquired taste that might not be to everyone's liking, especially those outside Japan."
mem/0005/5/p21: I often hear foreigners trying umeboshi and being shocked by the taste.
mem/0005/5/p22: "No, no. If a fairy recommended it, I'll try challenging myself with a new culture! It's an adventure!"
mem/0005/5/p23: I served him the umeboshi rice ball as he wished, but...
mem/0005/5/p24: "Ugh... this scent... It's so sour. I'm hesitant to even put it in my mouth."
mem/0005/5/p25: "That's the characteristic of umeboshi. If the smell bothers you, the taste will be even more of a shock."
mem/0005/5/p26: "Really that much?! Is it that sour!?"
mem/0005/5/p27: "I don't think I'm exaggerating. It gives you an indescribable sensation that makes your jaw ache."
mem/0005/5/p28: Depending on the amount and the person, it should be sour enough to make you salivate just hearing the word 'umeboshi'.
mem/0005/5/p29: "Then how about the tuna mayo? Does that have a stimulating taste too?"
mem/0005/5/p30: "Tuna mayo is made by mixing mayonnaise with flaked fish that's been cooked in oil. It's not spicy or sour."
mem/0005/5/p31: I replaced the umeboshi rice ball with one topped with tuna mayo.
mem/0005/5/p32: "That sounds safe. I'll go with that then. Let's eat!"
mem/0005/5/p33: He must have been hungry, because the moment I handed it to him, he dove into the rice ball with gusto.
mem/0005/5/p34: "Delicious! It's so good, Miss Fairy! I'm enjoying the visual contrast of the white rice and black seaweed, while the smooth flavor of the tuna mayo harmonizes perfectly with the mildly salty rice!"
mem/0005/5/p35: I had never heard anyone praise a rice ball so enthusiastically before.
mem/0005/5/p36: He spoke as if he were admiring a magnificent painting, all the while enthusiastically stuffing his face with rice balls.
mem/0005/5/p38: All that effort of waking up early to prepare it was worth it.
mem/0005/5/p40: Looking over at Totsuka, he had finished his first umeboshi rice ball and was reaching for a second one.
mem/0005/5/p41: In silence, he took bite after bite, the rice balls disappearing into his mouth before my eyes.
mem/0005/5/p42: "You're eating like a Tsuki-Tsuki! I've never seen Tsuki-Tsuki eat this fast! It's delicious, really delicious!"
mem/0005/5/p43: Totsuka gave a slight nod and began eating his third umeboshi rice ball.
mem/0005/5/p44: Balder also seemed to be enjoying his grilled meat rice ball at his own leisurely pace.
mem/0005/5/p46: "Okaka? What's that? What could it be? Is it related to chocolate?"
mem/0005/5/p47: "The one related to chocolate is 'cacao.' This is made from dried fish that's been shaved and seasoned with soy sauce."
mem/0005/5/p48: "You know everything, Miss Fairy. And you're also such a great cook. It's wonderful, really!"
mem/0005/5/p49: "I wouldn't say making rice balls counts as being skilled at cooking..."
mem/0005/5/p50: "I've heard that the simpler the dish, the more the difference in skill shows. This is delicious."
mem/0005/5/p51: "That's right. The way this meat is grilled is perfect, too."
mem/0005/5/p52: I felt a bit embarrassed being praised so freely, but I was happy to see them enjoying the food.
mem/0005/5/p53: Eating rice balls with friends while chatting casually felt like a feast, and we spent the best lunch break ever.
mem/0006/6/p0: As student council president, and as a member of the class, I really wanted the cultural festival to be a success.
mem/0006/6/p1: We worked hard and pulled together for that very reason... so why did I do such a thing back then?
mem/0006/6/p2: Since stepping down as student council president, I've been thinking about nothing else.
mem/0006/6/p3: What's already done can't be undone. No matter how much I regret it, the facts won't change.
mem/0006/6/p4: And above all, I couldn't shake the feeling that I had hurt her.
mem/0006/6/p5: The time we spent together flashed through my mind.
mem/0006/6/p6: "It's all my fault... I'm the worst kind of guy..."
mem/0006/6/p7: When things get this tough, I just run away from reality and waste my time doing nothing.
mem/0006/6/p8: Will I end up graduating without even earning my qualifications... like this?
mem/0006/6/p9: "I always fail at the crucial moments. The future I imagine never comes to pass."
mem/0006/6/p10: Doing things for everyone's sake only to end up causing them trouble-wasn't that just self-satisfaction?
mem/0006/6/p11: Such thoughts only served to blame me further.
mem/0006/6/p12: "What should I do... what can I do?"
mem/0006/6/p13: My muttering vanished into the air, and naturally, no answer came back.
mem/0006/6/p14: Sitting in my chair, I stared at the envelope in front of me.
mem/0006/6/p15: My name is written on it.
mem/0006/6/p16: When I took it out, the word 'Invitation' was written in elegant calligraphy.
mem/0006/6/p17: Inside the folded paper, the details of the cultural festival's appreciation party were listed.
mem/0006/6/p18: "To think they'd even invite someone like me..."
mem/0006/6/p19: It overflowed with the concern everyone had for me.
mem/0006/6/p20: Even without being written out, I could feel it painfully clearly.
mem/0006/6/p22: A urge to run away seized me, but the invitation in my hand felt like proof that I was needed.
mem/0006/6/p23: Start time: As soon as Apollon arrives at the venue.
mem/0006/6/p26: A smile slipped out involuntarily. At their kindness.
mem/0006/6/p27: "An invitation like this would only trouble everyone."
mem/0006/6/p28: There are people waiting for me.
mem/0006/6/p29: There are people pushing me forward, telling me it's okay to be here.
mem/0006/6/p30: What have I been looking at all this time?
mem/0006/6/p31: How could I have failed to notice I was surrounded by such wonderful companions?
mem/0006/6/p33: As I muttered that, the anxiety from earlier vanished as if it were a lie.
mem/0006/6/p34: In place of anxiety, everyone's feelings filled my chest.
mem/0006/6/p35: That's right. Moping and worrying won't get me anywhere. I'll just do what I can do.
mem/0006/6/p37: I took a deep breath and started walking toward the venue.
mem/0007/7/p0: When I first saw her, I felt a sense of familiarity.
mem/0007/7/p1: Even though we had just met, it felt as if I had known her for a long time.
mem/0007/7/p2: Her eyes widened in surprise, staring fixedly at me. They were strong, direct, and beautifully bright.
mem/0007/7/p3: And that gentle smile reminded me of Cassandra.
mem/0007/7/p4: I didn't realize that until some time had passed.
mem/0007/7/p5: I first met Cassandra when I was losing the people dear to me one by one.
mem/0007/7/p6: Overwhelmed by a grief so deep I didn't know what to do, even the gods turned their backs on me.
mem/0007/7/p7: At that time, I heard a voice calling my name from afar.
mem/0007/7/p8: The voice was small, but firm, and it continued without ceasing.
mem/0007/7/p10: ~I want you to listen to me~
mem/0007/7/p12: She kept calling out to me without giving up.
mem/0007/7/p13: Her sincere feelings grew stronger day by day, and before I knew it, they had opened my firmly closed heart.
mem/0007/7/p16: She said that with a smile.
mem/0007/7/p17: Even though it must have been a rather long time within the span of a human's limited life.
mem/0007/7/p18: "Why did you wait for me? I wasn't guaranteed to come."
mem/0007/7/p19: I had no intention of talking, yet my mouth spun out words against my will.
mem/0007/7/p20: I had only thought to catch a glimpse of her figure... that was all.
mem/0007/7/p21: "...But you appeared. That fact alone is enough for me."
mem/0007/7/p22: Her words, "I believed in you," gently wrapped around my heart, and I felt they were the truth.
mem/0007/7/p23: "Then, why did you call for me? There must be a reason you prayed so desperately."
mem/0007/7/p26: "You are hurting and suffering inside. It becomes unbearable just to watch you..."
mem/0007/7/p27: A shadow of sorrow fell across her beautiful eyes. There was no lie in that expression. At least, that's what I thought.
mem/0007/7/p28: "I will dedicate myself to staying by Lord Apollon's side. Though a human like me may be unworthy, please... calm your heart."

mem/0007/7/p32: A smile reminiscent of Cassandra, strong feelings...

mem/0008/8/p2: Getting involved with that man never ends well.
mem/0008/8/p3: He does things his own way, selfishly and capriciously. The summoning to the Garden this time was no exception.
mem/0008/8/p4: I had intended to spend my time quietly, alone, and avoiding contact with anyone.

mem/0008/8/p11: Resisting his innocence and earnestness is very difficult.

mem/0008/8/p13: While he led everyone cheerfully as student council president, I was troubled by the lonely expression he showed when speaking with Zeus.
mem/0008/8/p14: The frustration of not knowing how to express my feelings. Despite being my closest blood relative, we kept missing each other.
mem/0008/8/p15: Does the wretched history of children killing their parents cause this?
mem/0008/8/p16: Or is it weakness and insecurity that prevent us from trusting one another?
mem/0008/8/p17: Parent and child are probing each other.
mem/0008/8/p18: I don't know if I, who can't even fix things between myself and Zeus, can do anything for Apollon.
mem/0008/8/p19: Still, I wanted to be of some help.
mem/0008/8/p20: I just want Apollon to be able to smile, no matter what.
mem/0008/8/p21: I hope he's happy... that's all I wish for.
mem/0008/8/p22: ...It seems spending time with Apollon has made me soft.
mem/0008/8/p23: Thinking like this isn't like me at all.
mem/0008/8/p24: Sighing at my own complacency, I started walking toward the dorms.

mem/0009/9/p3: Or rather, I let her say it.

mem/0009/9/p5: If I could, I would have wished for that moment to never come.
mem/0009/9/p6: The same goes for this very moment.
mem/0009/9/p7: She is truly, truly strong to the end.
mem/0009/9/p8: She's the one hurting, yet she says the words I hesitated to say.
mem/0009/9/p9: That's why I fell in love with her.
mem/0009/9/p10: I bite my lip hard, trying to hold back tears, gently wipe hers away, and put on a brave face.
mem/0009/9/p11: I act silly on purpose, pretending everything is fine.
mem/0009/9/p12: Of course, I'm not fine at all. After all, I couldn't even say goodbye.
mem/0009/9/p13: I'm desperately trying to convince myself not to cry. Not to cry...
mem/0009/9/p14: "Don't go, {NAME}. Stay with me. Please... okay?"
mem/0009/9/p15: I put on a bright smile, masking my true feelings, but she's smart enough to realize it's impossible and looked down.
mem/0009/9/p16: Tears from her cheek spill onto my hand.
mem/0009/9/p17: Why do we have to part, even though we care so much for each other?
mem/0009/9/p18: Is it because fate has decided it so?
mem/0009/9/p19: So what! I don't want to lose what's precious to me anymore. I refuse to give up.
mem/0009/9/p20: I want to stay together forever... I don't want to give you to anyone else.
mem/0009/9/p21: Even fate must not be allowed to tear us apart.
mem/0009/9/p22: "But we both have paths we must walk... I can't change our fate of parting with just my own power. It's very sad."
mem/0009/9/p23: I tell her words contrary to my heart, smiling.
mem/0009/9/p24: Because I believe it's the best choice for her.
mem/0009/9/p25: What matters is her own life, not my feelings or desires.
mem/0009/9/p26: I've come to think this way because I met her. Before that, I might have just forcibly taken her away.
mem/0009/9/p27: So, with gratitude in my heart, I decide to support her resolve.
mem/0009/9/p30: So I let go of your hand. My cute, cute fairy.
mem/0010/10/p0: "It's time for us to part too..."
mem/0010/10/p1: Words that make me sad even when I say them myself.
mem/0010/10/p2: I didn't want to say it if I could help it, but I figured I should be the one to bring it up as a man... so I started talking...
mem/0010/10/p4: She said something unbelievable with such a serious expression.
mem/0010/10/p6: Does that mean it's not a goodbye?
mem/0010/10/p7: I still can't believe it. Could she really do that?
mem/0010/10/p8: But I know she isn't the type to joke around in a situation like this.

mem/0010/10/p10: She widened her large eyes and pleaded with me earnestly.
mem/0010/10/p11: You must have made a huge decision.
mem/0010/10/p12: When I think that she did it for me, I get so, so happy.
mem/0010/10/p13: What do I do, what do I do!
mem/0010/10/p14: I thought I loved her more, but I never imagined she loved me just as much.
mem/0010/10/p16: Seeing her peek at my face with such anxiety, I realized I had been silent.
mem/0010/10/p20: "I'm happy, but I'll be fine. I can manage on my own. So, you should go back to your own world."
mem/0010/10/p21: I tried saying the opposite of what I really felt.
mem/0010/10/p22: I don't know why, but a mischievous impulse made me do it.
mem/0010/10/p23: Because she is so cute, and I might still not be able to believe that someone like her looks up to me.
mem/0010/10/p24: She's far too wonderful for me. Maybe she'd be happier if she stayed away from someone like me.
mem/0010/10/p27: She didn't move a muscle, as if time had stopped.
mem/0010/10/p28: I must have shocked her terribly... I need to take it back quickly.
mem/0010/10/p29: But before I could even think to correct myself,
mem/0010/10/p30: "W-Why are you saying such a thing?"
mem/0010/10/p31: Did I just imagine all of that?
mem/0010/10/p32: Was our mutual understanding just an illusion?
mem/0010/10/p33: Or was it wrong of me to make a decision without consulting you?
mem/0010/10/p34: Humans say things are 'written all over your face,' and that's exactly what was happening.

mem/0010/10/p36: It seems I didn't need any prophetic powers for this.
mem/0010/10/p37: Every one of her reactions was so cute and ticklish. How happy I am.
mem/0010/10/p38: I shouldn't laugh, but she changes her expression so quickly that it's hard to hold it in.
mem/0010/10/p39: But I want to feel the fact that she loves me for as long as possible.
mem/0010/10/p40: Ah, but I might be reaching my limit. The fairy is just too cute; I can't hold back!
mem/0010/10/p41: "......Hahahaha, don't make that face. It's just a joke, obviously."
mem/0010/10/p42: After bursting out laughing, I crafted my words to bring a smile to your relieved face.
mem/0011/11/p0: Apollo's mother was Leto, a beautiful daughter of the Titan race. The two fell in love, and Leto became pregnant with Apollo.
mem/0011/11/p1: Apollo's birth was a difficult labor that lasted nine days and nine nights.
mem/0011/11/p2: The other gods worried for Leto's health and offered their help, but I could only watch.
mem/0011/11/p3: Even though it was my own doing, the shame of being unable to protect my child remains etched in my heart to this day.
mem/0011/11/p4: When I heard he was born safely and rushed to her side, I found a bright, healthy boy radiating vitality.
mem/0011/11/p5: Seeing that child, a love I had never felt before surged within my chest.
mem/0011/11/p6: I gently wrapped my arms around his small body and held him close.
mem/0011/11/p8: As if responding to my voice, my son stared at me with adorable eyes and opened his mouth wide in a smile.
mem/0011/11/p10: I found myself smiling in return. When one is truly happy from the bottom of one's heart, a smile naturally appears. I had forgotten such a simple truth.
mem/0011/11/p11: "Do you know that I am your father?"
mem/0011/11/p12: Even though I knew a toddler couldn't understand words, I couldn't help but speak to him.
mem/0011/11/p13: In response, Apollo flapped his arms.
mem/0011/11/p14: "A wise and beautiful child. My beloved son..."
mem/0011/11/p15: I lost count of how many times I showered him with words of admiration.
mem/0011/11/p16: However, along with that joy came a question: how exactly should I love my son?
mem/0011/11/p17: Despite him being someone I should love, I felt a fear for his future.
mem/0011/11/p18: I succeeded my father, Cronus, and took on the role of leading the gods as an omniscient and omnipotent deity. But it all began with killing him.
mem/0011/11/p19: The memory of destroying my father, Cronus, flashed through my mind. The doubt turned into confusion, tormenting me.
mem/0011/11/p20: Since I have never experienced being loved by a father, I do not know how to dote on my son.
mem/0011/11/p21: Even when Apollo clings to me, can I accept it?
mem/0011/11/p22: Do I even have the qualifications for this?
mem/0011/11/p23: A distance grew between me and Apollon, eventually turning into a wide chasm.
mem/0011/11/p24: However, there wasn't a single day when I didn't think of Apollon.
mem/0011/11/p25: All I could do was watch over him and guide him onto the right path...
mem/0011/11/p26: Believing that was the only thing I could do as a parent, I invited Apollon to this academy.
mem/0012/12/p0: "Uncle, school life was so, so fun, wasn't it?"
mem/0012/12/p1: Apollon skipped lightly, hopping cheerfully around Hades.
mem/0012/12/p3: "It was like heaven! Heaven! We made so, so many good memories."
mem/0012/12/p4: He counted them off on his fingers, snapping them repeatedly as if one hand wasn't enough.
mem/0012/12/p6: Muttering that, Hades stopped in his tracks.
mem/0012/12/p8: "That's the exact opposite of where you're going now. ...Are you sure? Really?"
mem/0012/12/p9: Lacking confidence, he stared down at the ground.
mem/0012/12/p10: The Underworld is inhabited only by the dead and those who manage them.
mem/0012/12/p11: After all, no one would willingly visit a place shunned and feared. It's no wonder the King of the Underworld is confused.
mem/0012/12/p12: "But Uncle, you'll be with me, right?"
mem/0012/12/p13: "That's true. It's not a place you could go alone."
mem/0012/12/p14: "Then it'll be fun anywhere, absolutely. It's already decided!"
mem/0012/12/p16: Hades put his hands to his head, exasperated by his cheerful nephew.
mem/0012/12/p17: "There's no way Uncle's world is bad! Uncle is wonderful, after all. He's my pride and joy!"
mem/0012/12/p19: "Is that so? I want to see Cerberus again! That kid from the sports festival!"
mem/0012/12/p20: "Don't compare him to some random dog. He's the guardian of the Underworld. He mercilessly catches and devours anyone who tries to escape."
mem/0012/12/p21: "But Didi said he loves sweets and calms down if you give him snacks. He's a lot like Uncle Hades, isn't he? Do guardians resemble their masters?"
mem/0012/12/p23: "I want to hear more about the Underworld! What's it like?"
mem/0012/12/p24: Ignoring Hades, Apollon fired question after question.
mem/0012/12/p25: "Understood. Don't say I didn't warn you."
mem/0012/12/p26: He took a single, quiet breath and began to speak with a solemn expression.
mem/0012/12/p27: "...The Underworld is shrouded in darkness. Once you step foot inside, you cannot leave without the King's permission."
mem/0012/12/p29: "So, if I don't allow it, you'll never be able to return to the surface."
mem/0012/12/p30: He whispered in a low, gravelly voice.
mem/0012/12/p34: Seeing Apollon's wide-eyed expression, Hades answered with a hint of smugness.
mem/0012/12/p35: "You mean you want me to stay in the Underworld forever! That's it, right? That's what you're saying, right?"
mem/0012/12/p37: "Because if I can't go back, it means Uncle is trying to keep me here because he doesn't want me to leave, right? Since I can't return without his permission."
mem/0012/12/p39: "Or, is Uncle worried that if I go to the Underworld, it'll become too bright? If it gets bright, it won't feel like the Underworld anymore, right?"
mem/0012/12/p40: "...It's not a problem if it doesn't feel like the Underworld."
mem/0012/12/p41: When Hades answered like that, Apollon's eyes lit up with joy.
mem/0012/12/p42: "Then I guess I'll stay in the Underworld for a while! I'll put my heart into it and make it bright!"
mem/0012/12/p43: "In a bright Underworld, my mood is... ah, so light..."
mem/0012/12/p44: A cheerful Apollon and a blunt Hades.
mem/0012/12/p45: The strange journey of the nephew and uncle to the Underworld has just begun. Only the gods know how it will end... And how will the light and dark play out...?
