mem/0028/28/p27: "Ah, right. Kuro-rin was also born in September. And since it's late in the month... Libra?"
mem/0028/28/p29: "The lucky item to change your future is... a fork!"
mem/0028/28/p31: While the junior was diligently working on the screen, the former mentor who had trained them was looking over here with a smug grin.
mem/0028/28/p33: Camus took out the small fork that had been stuck in his cake and handed it to me.
mem/0028/28/p34: "It's supposed to be a lucky item. Want to use it?"
mem/0028/28/p36: To repeat myself, I don't believe in fortune telling. I just happened to see it by chance.
mem/0028/28/p37: But I never imagined it would connect like that. I didn't think it would turn out like this.
mem/0028/28/p38: After the Christmas live, I would become his official partner and aim for victory at the Song Festival.
mem/0028/28/p40: After working together for a while, I felt that his musical talent and passion for music were genuine. I thought I could acknowledge him.
mem/0028/28/p41: And so, the Christmas live ended to great success. But... that night...
mem/0028/28/p43: Just as I was about to bring up the subject of being partners with him, Camus, who had interrupted, suddenly said that.
mem/0028/28/p45: I had always thought he was someone whose thoughts were hard to read, but...
mem/0028/28/p46: Even he probably said at first that he was done looking after rookies. What's gotten into him now? And at a time like this...
mem/0028/28/p48: -A rival for love has appeared. Big trouble!-
mem/0028/28/p49: A rival... for love? No, wait. Setting aside the love part for a moment.
mem/0028/28/p50: So, just like me, Camus has also come to recognize this guy's musical talent through the Christmas live?
mem/0028/28/p51: He's a calculating sort, so that makes sense when you think about it.
mem/0028/28/p52: But... I can't just hand this guy over to some shady character like that without a fight.
mem/0028/28/p53: I stepped in between him and Camus.
mem/0028/28/p54: Camus made a face that openly showed his displeasure.
mem/0028/28/p55: "Don't get in my way, Blackthorn. This doesn't concern you."
mem/0028/28/p56: "Of course it concerns me. This guy is my partner... well, he wasn't yet..."
mem/0028/28/p57: I felt a slight regret that I hadn't brought it up sooner.
mem/0028/28/p58: But the moment I mentioned 'partner,' the guy who had been looking confused, caught between me and Camus, looked at me with serious eyes.
mem/0028/28/p59: He said nothing, just waiting quietly for me to finish my sentence.
mem/0028/28/p60: I should have taken my time to talk it through... but...
mem/0028/28/p62: Ah, screw it. Anyway, it's all about momentum! Momentum! This is too much trouble.
mem/0028/28/p63: Before Camus could say anything else, I declared that I'd make him my partner.
mem/0028/28/p64: "You too... is that okay with you?"
mem/0028/28/p65: At my final push, he quickly nodded in agreement.
mem/0028/28/p66: As for Camus, I expected him to push back, but he gave up on being my partner without a second thought.
mem/0028/28/p67: Did they think they could pull one over on me, or was it just a whim...? Either way, I still don't get it.
mem/0028/28/p68: On the way back, he timidly asked me if what I'd said about us being partners was true.
mem/0028/28/p69: "I'm serious," I told him, and he looked relieved.
mem/0028/28/p70: Things got a bit out of order, but I have no regrets about what I said.
mem/0028/28/p71: He's a music maniac to the core, and honestly, trying out some more music with this guy who's a bit like me doesn't sound like a bad idea.
mem/0028/28/p72: "By the way, I found the footage from your session with Hinata-san."
mem/0028/28/p74: "Come see me later. We can also talk about the songs for the singing festival."
mem/0028/28/p77: So, what kind of song is this guy going to make for me?
mem/0029/29/p0: I packed up my meager savings and a single bass, then headed to Tokyo.
mem/0029/29/p1: This town was overflowing with people, far more than back home.
mem/0029/29/p2: Bring it on. I'll make sure this succeeds here. That's what I thought.
mem/0029/29/p3: But my resolve was mercilessly swallowed by the waves of reality.
mem/0029/29/p4: Since I was slowly paying off the debt my father left behind, the savings I'd gathered at home ran out quickly.
mem/0029/29/p5: I picked up extra day shifts to earn enough to eat, while working at a live music venue at night.
mem/0029/29/p6: But nothing lasted long, and as I added more, I couldn't keep up with the time or my own body.
mem/0029/29/p7: In the end, I spent those days scraping by with whatever day labor paid well.
mem/0029/29/p8: It was mid-December by then, and the town was glowing with festive illuminations.
mem/0029/29/p9: While everyone else was high on Christmas cheer, I walked alone, weaving through the crowd on my way home.
mem/0029/29/p10: My grueling day job had finally ended, but the money I earned vanished instantly, sucked up by overdue rent and debts.
mem/0029/29/p11: I hadn't had a proper meal in about three days.
mem/0029/29/p12: I'd come straight home from work, so I felt like my whole body was covered in soot.
mem/0029/29/p13: I knew that even if I went home, there wouldn't be a single grain of rice left.
mem/0029/29/p14: It felt pathetic and miserable to think about how hard it was just to survive.
mem/0029/29/p15: Fatigue, drowsiness, and hunger attacked me mercilessly even as I walked.
mem/0029/29/p16: I just wanted them to pick one and get it over with.
mem/0029/29/p17: I couldn't take it anymore and collapsed onto the side of the road.
mem/0029/29/p19: I just wanted to sleep somewhere, anywhere. If I slept, I could forget about my hunger.
mem/0029/29/p20: It wasn't a real solution, but I thought that would be better.
mem/0029/29/p22: The sun had long set, and the air was cold enough to suggest snow.
mem/0029/29/p23: "If it starts snowing now, I'll be a snowman by morning..."
mem/0029/29/p24: As my consciousness began to blur...
mem/0029/29/p27: "W-what is it...! A dog? No, a person...?"
mem/0029/29/p28: When I looked, an unfamiliar old man was staring at me with wide eyes, having fallen on his rear.
mem/0029/29/p30: Another face popped up from behind.
mem/0029/29/p32: It was an old woman, but like the old man, she made a twisted face at me.
mem/0029/29/p35: "Ah, ah, I'm sorry. I was startled..."
mem/0029/29/p36: Hearing that, I finally remembered my own appearance.
mem/0029/29/p37: Messy hair, disheveled clothes, an exhausted face. I probably had dark circles under my eyes too.
mem/0029/29/p38: It might be understandable, but even as I thought that, sleepiness overtook me.
mem/0029/29/p39: "Ah, you? What are you doing here? Are you okay?"
mem/0029/29/p41: Had I reached my limit? My eyelids slowly drooped.
mem/0029/29/p42: "Hii! Oh, you mustn't give up on living!"
mem/0029/29/p45: A hamburger steak and rice were placed in front of me.
mem/0029/29/p46: I gasped at the steam rising from the freshly cooked food. The white dishes were blindingly bright, and every time the aroma of the sauce tickled my nose, I felt dizzy.
mem/0029/29/p47: By chance, the spot where I was sitting was in front of a restaurant. At first, I hadn't noticed at all, but when I looked at the door, there was indeed a small sign.
mem/0029/29/p48: The old man was the owner of this shop. He gave my cheek, where I had been dozing off, a solid slap to wake me up and led me inside.
mem/0029/29/p49: He actually slapped me hard, saying, 'You'll die if you sleep here,' so my cheek hurt for a while.
mem/0029/29/p50: "When you're in trouble, we're all in the same boat. Eat up."
mem/0029/29/p51: There were no other customers in the shop, so I sat across from the old man at the table.
mem/0029/29/p52: My hand holding the fork trembled slightly.
mem/0029/29/p54: I cautiously cut a piece of meat and put it in my mouth.
mem/0029/29/p56: The taste was so good my vision blurred. It had been a really long time.
mem/0029/29/p58: "You can have more rice if you want, so don't hold back."
mem/0029/29/p59: I ate with single-minded focus, and before I realized it, I had finished everything.
mem/0029/29/p62: I felt like I had come back to life...
mem/0029/29/p63: "I wish I had noticed sooner... Oh?"
mem/0029/29/p64: The old woman looked up at the clock.
mem/0029/29/p65: "Grandpa, it's about time for your reserved guests."
mem/0029/29/p68: "That's right, that's right. Some local soccer team's send-off party or something. I kept it open just for that today."
mem/0029/29/p69: Before five minutes had passed, the doorbell rang, and a group of customers filed in.
mem/0029/29/p71: The old woman started taking orders in a flurry. The old man was in the kitchen. The shop didn't employ any other staff.
mem/0029/29/p72: I left my seat and headed for the kitchen.
mem/0029/29/p77: "That won't do. I'll work it off here, right now. Got it?"
mem/0029/29/p78: The old man stared blankly for about a minute, then put a hat on my head and told me to wash the dishes.
mem/0029/29/p79: From then on, I ended up working part-time at this shop.
mem/0029/29/p80: It seemed even the old man felt uneasy about putting me on the floor, so I went into the kitchen. I had never really cooked before, but I was dexterous with my hands, so I got used to it quickly.
mem/0029/29/p81: More importantly, thanks to my parents not spoiling me and making sure I ate proper food, I apparently had a reliable palate.
mem/0029/29/p82: My cooking improved enough to be accepted by the regulars.
mem/0029/29/p83: Eventually, I settled into a life shuttling between part-time work at this restaurant and helping out at the live house.
mem/0029/29/p84: I was still broke, but the fact that I didn't have to worry about food since I worked at a restaurant was a blessing.
mem/0029/29/p85: And so, one day while working in the kitchen, I was scouted to become an idol by the owner's father.
mem/0029/29/p86: He must have tracked down my part-time job at the restaurant right after watching my live performance and came straight here.
mem/0029/29/p88: Right after I served the omurice, he shouted for me to come to the counter.
mem/0029/29/p91: A stranger I didn't know started by saying that to me.
mem/0029/29/p92: I had braced myself, thinking he was just another complainer criticizing the food, so I was relieved.
mem/0029/29/p93: Meanwhile, the spoon eating the omurice kept moving steadily.
mem/0029/29/p94: "Hmm, delicious! Exactly as the rumors say."
mem/0029/29/p96: I offered a polite thanks in return.
mem/0029/29/p97: The man in front of me nodded deeply, scooped up the remaining third of the omurice in one go, and put it in his mouth.
mem/0029/29/p98: "It might be good for you to stay on as a cook here. YOUR skills are solid. BUT..."
mem/0029/29/p99: Wiping the ketchup from the corner of his mouth and adjusting his sunglasses, the man said,
mem/0029/29/p100: "I felt the cry of your heart in YOUR song. What you truly want to do is music... Is that right?"
mem/0029/29/p101: He asked me to come to the agency right away, but I hesitated when I heard it was an idol agency.
mem/0029/29/p102: I had received several such scouting offers before, for modeling and the like, but what I truly wanted to do was music.
mem/0029/29/p103: It might be selfish, but once I had decided on music, I felt I couldn't waver, even if it meant chasing success through it.
mem/0029/29/p104: However, the owner's father promised to protect the music I had built up to this point.
mem/0029/29/p105: That is why I, who had been dedicated solely to rock, was able to dive into this world.
mem/0029/29/p106: As long as I could continue making music, I made sure to do my duties as an idol, such as variety shows and talk segments, properly.
mem/0029/29/p107: ...And that brings us to the present.
mem/0029/29/p108: Today happens to be the same season as when I first visited the shop. Learning that the Kurosaki family was involved with that restaurant, I felt a strange sense of connection.
mem/0029/29/p109: It seems people are connected in ways you'd never expect.
mem/0029/29/p110: There were hardships, but I've finally found a stable life.
mem/0029/29/p111: I have my music, and now I have dreams for the future.
mem/0029/29/p112: And most importantly, I have a precious partner.
mem/0029/29/p113: Every encounter led me to this moment. Now, I can simply feel grateful.
mem/0029/29/p114: I burst out of the shop, pulling him along as we run.
mem/0029/29/p115: I swore to the starry sky that I would cherish our bond and never let go of the hand I held.
mem/0030/30/p0: It was a spring day, some time after we had started dating.
mem/0030/30/p1: My schedule was packed from the morning, just like any other day.
mem/0030/30/p2: I slipped out of bed quietly so as not to wake him.
mem/0030/30/p3: I washed my face and fixed my hair. It tends to get messy when I sleep, but I'll leave the bedhead for a bit of character.
mem/0030/30/p4: After getting ready as usual, I brushed my teeth and fed the cat that had just arrived. There used to be two, but for some reason, only this one shows up lately.
mem/0030/30/p5: As I was thinking it was time to leave, I glanced at the table and noticed a small package and a note.
mem/0030/30/p6: "These are leftovers from yesterday, made into a bento. Good luck at work. {NAME}"
mem/0030/30/p8: Though a few questions lingered, seeing the note in his handwriting warmed my heart.
mem/0030/30/p9: I still peeked into the room where he was sleeping.
mem/0030/30/p11: I whispered it softly and placed a gentle kiss on his sleeping face. Then, I left the single key on the doorpost and stepped out of the house.
mem/0030/30/p12: It's been a while since we started dating, but whenever something like this happens in the morning, I can't help but let my guard down.
mem/0030/30/p13: After the Song Festival, we became partners in both work and private life. Sometimes our days off overlap, and he comes to my place. He can't stay long, but that's fine with me.
mem/0030/30/p14: Until March, we were often together because I was composing music for the Song Festival, but now that it's over, it's surprisingly hard to just be by his side.
mem/0030/30/p15: As soon as the Song Festival ended, I got swamped with work. More importantly, thanks to his debut, his workload increased too. It's all a blessing, though.
mem/0030/30/p16: Maybe I should just get married already. If we're husband and wife, I won't have to worry about what people think anymore....
mem/0030/30/p17: ...No, what am I thinking? I still have debts to pay off, and I can't let him go without anything in the future. I need to work hard first... That's where the real talk begins.
mem/0030/30/p18: To force my mind back to work, I slapped my face repeatedly.
mem/0030/30/p21: I finished my first job of the morning, and after lunch, I had a meeting for a new variety show.
mem/0030/30/p22: Reiji, Ai, and Camus were already at the meeting site.
mem/0030/30/p23: We regularly get projects working together as a group. It seems we've officially become a team.
mem/0030/30/p24: "So, you see~. I'm the soothing green one."
mem/0030/30/p25: This time, there's a skit where we dress up as a superhero team. I glanced at the script, but I don't really understand it. Somehow, there's even a dedicated theme song.
mem/0030/30/p26: "Isn't the leader of a superhero team usually red?"
mem/0030/30/p27: "This time, the theme is healing! The name is 'Healing Squad Quartet*4!'"
mem/0030/30/p29: As we were arguing, the conference room door opened.
mem/0030/30/p30: "Good work today. This is Kusanagi... Please treat me well..."
mem/0030/30/p32: The script slipped from my hand with a clatter.
mem/0030/30/p34: Reiji immediately stood up from his seat.
mem/0030/30/p36: My script landed at Camus's feet.
mem/0030/30/p37: Since there was no sign of anyone picking it up, I silently bent down to retrieve it.
mem/0030/30/p38: I had heard about it, of course. I had only spoken with him a few days ago about him being in charge of the songs for the program.
mem/0030/30/p39: But I had never heard that we'd be working on the same project.
mem/0030/30/p40: "Isn't this the first time since the post-festival party? How've you been?"
mem/0030/30/p41: "Y-yes, I'm fine! I'm glad to see everyone else is doing well too!"
mem/0030/30/p43: "Ah, it's for work. I've been assigned to compose the songs performed in the program... I never expected it to be all of you..."
mem/0030/30/p44: "I see. You're certainly the right person for the job. You know the vocal ranges and quirks of all four of us."
mem/0030/30/p45: It seemed like he was hearing about my presence here for the first time, and he wore an expression of not knowing how to react.
mem/0030/30/p46: When we inevitably ran into each other on set, things felt strangely awkward between us.
mem/0030/30/p47: After a moment's hesitation, he sat down in the seat opposite mine.
mem/0030/30/p48: At times like these, it's a delicate matter whether I should make eye contact or look away.
mem/0030/30/p49: As I was hesitating, Ai turned a suspicious gaze toward me.
mem/0030/30/p53: Ai pointed it out, and I realized the script in my hands was indeed flipped.
mem/0030/30/p54: "Were you waiting for me to catch on?"
mem/0030/30/p55: Don't ask that with a straight face.
mem/0030/30/p57: I kept a blank expression, flipped the script over with a snap, and set it right.
mem/0030/30/p59: Reiji, sitting next to me, was struggling to hold back his laughter. He was the only one who seemed to know why I was so flustered.
mem/0030/30/p60: I'm going to make him pay for this later.
mem/0030/30/p61: I calmed myself down and reached for the coffee on the desk.
mem/0030/30/p63: As he said that, Camus also reached for his cup. In the collision, the paper cup tipped over, spilling its contents all over the desk in front of us.
mem/0030/30/p65: {NAME} let out a startled cry upon seeing it.
mem/0030/30/p68: At that address, everyone in the room turned their gaze toward me.
mem/0030/30/p70: He finally realized his slip-up, his face turning bright red as he corrected himself.
mem/0030/30/p72: After the meeting ended, as expected, Rinei was the first to bring it up.
mem/0030/30/p73: "Oh my, you can't keep your hands off your big brother, can you? Weren't you sending each other love telepathies the whole time?"
mem/0030/30/p75: Unfortunately, after that, we had a recording for 'Mai-do! Idol Las Vegas,' which Rinei and I were both appearing on.
mem/0030/30/p76: Our schedules aligned perfectly, so we had no choice but to walk down the hallway together.
mem/0030/30/p77: "Haha, but hey, Ai-ai and Miu-chan noticed too. I felt the tension from the moment Ranran dropped the script."
mem/0030/30/p78: "Forget those two, but you better not say a word."
mem/0030/30/p79: "No, no, no! I'm super tight-lipped, you know that?"
mem/0030/30/p81: I didn't blame him for it, but I was a little crushed that it was so easily blown.
mem/0030/30/p82: "Ranran and the junior girl are both terrible at lying. ...Actually, your love is leaking out everywhere. You should tell the agency before they find out. Or should I gently break the news for you?"
mem/0030/30/p83: "Just to check, what do you plan on saying?"
mem/0030/30/p84: "We're close enough that she calls me 'Ranmaru-san'*"
mem/0030/30/p87: "Right, today's recording had a singing segment, didn't it?"
mem/0030/30/p89: "I'll turn that whole segment into a death-metal vocal showcase and wreck your voice."
mem/0030/30/p90: "Huh?! My singing career is suddenly in danger!?"
mem/0030/30/p91: Just as we were about to enter the recording studio, my phone rang. It was a text message from {NAME}.
mem/0030/30/p92: "Sorry about earlier. Are you okay? I was thinking of just having dinner together tonight, but what time will you be back?"
mem/0030/30/p94: I hate that I feel better after that hit. But honestly, I'm glad.
mem/0030/30/p95: "Huh? A love letter from a junior?"
mem/0030/30/p97: Too tired to resist, I answered that way, and Reiji looked like he'd seen something truly terrifying.
mem/0030/30/p101: While Reiji made a huge fuss, I replied to the message.
mem/0030/30/p102: "I'm coming home early. Wait for me."
mem/0030/30/p103: After that, I managed to wrap up work early and headed back to my apartment.
mem/0030/30/p105: Despite looking a bit embarrassed, he came to greet me.
mem/0030/30/p106: He was sitting huddled in the shadows of the apartment building, holding a grocery bag.
mem/0030/30/p107: "You...... if someone thinks you're a suspicious person and calls the cops, what are you going to do?"
mem/0030/30/p108: "I-I thought you might be coming soon, so..."
mem/0030/30/p111: He pulled my hand up to help me stand, and while he was at it, opened the outdoor mailbox.
mem/0030/30/p113: "Ah! Sorry. Actually, I took it home with me today."
mem/0030/30/p114: He hurriedly pulled the key out of his bag. I always tell him to leave it in the outdoor mailbox when he leaves, but he sometimes forgets, and once, I ended up locked out of my own house.
mem/0030/30/p115: "If you've got it, just go ahead and open it yourself."
mem/0030/30/p117: He's strangely proper about things like that.
mem/0030/30/p118: After that, we opened the front door together.
mem/0030/30/p119: Our usual room, which isn't particularly spacious, welcomed us. It's brutally hot in the summer and freezing in the winter, but right now, the temperature is just right.
mem/0030/30/p120: "Hehe, I'm home. That's what you say, right?"
mem/0030/30/p122: I felt strangely embarrassed by the situation of us having come home together.
mem/0030/30/p123: As he was about to put down the shopping bags, I casually pressed the small package I'd brought into his hand.
mem/0030/30/p125: I stood in the kitchen and turned on the stove for the kettle.
mem/0030/30/p129: He opened the package and his eyes widened. It was a brand-new, silver key, different from the one I had.
mem/0030/30/p130: "A key to my house... Are you sure it's okay?"
mem/0030/30/p131: "It's a hassle to make you wait outside, but on the other hand, I'd be in trouble if you accidentally took it home and got locked out."
mem/0030/30/p133: "Come over whenever you want. I don't mind if it's you."
mem/0030/30/p134: After a pause, I felt him timidly grasp the hem of my clothes.
mem/0030/30/p135: I looked down and saw him standing there, his face bright red.
mem/0030/30/p138: It wasn't exactly a thoughtful gift for a lover.
mem/0030/30/p140: Even so, he held the key tightly, a happy look on his face.
mem/0030/30/p142: Hearing that, I could no longer hold back. I reached out and touched his back.
mem/0030/30/p143: I pulled him close and embraced him, holding him tight.
mem/0030/30/p145: He blinked in my arms. Ignoring that, I tightened my grip.
mem/0030/30/p148: "I thought I should just say what I feel when I'm with you... Otherwise, you won't understand."
mem/0030/30/p150: I gently brushed the soft hair falling over his ear and leaned in closer.
mem/0030/30/p152: "Hey, you're going back to calling me 'senpai'."
mem/0030/30/p153: "B-because... after today's incident, I just got embarrassed again..."
mem/0030/30/p154: Even as he spoke, his ears turned red before my eyes.
mem/0030/30/p155: "Sure, it's surprising to be called by name in public... but just as I thought I could finally call you by your name..."
mem/0030/30/p157: But it's fine. It's just like you.
mem/0030/30/p158: I loosened my embrace and pressed my lips to the back of his neck two or three times.
mem/0030/30/p159: Sometimes I worry that if I hold him too tightly, he might break.
mem/0030/30/p160: It's only natural that I feel this way, since he's the first person I've ever loved like this.
mem/0030/30/p161: The light I finally found in you. The only goddess who illuminates my world.
mem/0030/30/p162: It's not like me to sing songs of love. It's not like me to believe in eternity.
mem/0030/30/p163: Anyone who knew me back then would probably be shocked.
mem/0030/30/p164: But... this is who I am now. I intend to dedicate my life to one woman. Isn't that a pretty rock-and-roll way to live?
mem/0030/30/p168: I gently patted his head, and he squinted his eyes in ticklish delight.
mem/0030/30/p169: "Next time... I'll make it for you again."
mem/0030/30/p171: "No. I should be the one saying... thank you."
mem/0030/30/p172: Thank you for loving me. Thank you for choosing me.
mem/0030/30/p173: I can't quite put it into words...
mem/0030/30/p174: I love you. This time, I'll be your light.
mem/0030/30/p175: The lid of the kettle on the stove began to rattle.
mem/0030/30/p178: I reached out and turned off the stove.
mem/0030/30/p179: "But, let's keep it like this for a bit longer."
mem/0030/30/p180: He said that, then pulled me back into his embrace.
mem/0030/30/p181: It was some time after that before we truly began living together.
mem/0031/31/p1: "I've already welcomed the day before the moon has fully set."
mem/0031/31/p2: I have no choice but to fulfill my duties as a disciplinary committee member today.
mem/0031/31/p3: Stand by in the classroom at dawn and investigate whether the gods are adhering to the school's rules.
mem/0031/31/p4: That was the instruction given to me by Thoth Caduceus, but I forgot to confirm what time 'dawn' actually is.
mem/0031/31/p5: "If it's right after sunrise, I suppose that counts as early morning."
mem/0031/31/p7: I began preparing to head to the academy.
mem/0031/31/p8: I pay the utmost attention even when getting dressed.
mem/0031/31/p9: It's a problem if the person enforcing the rules isn't following them themselves.
mem/0031/31/p10: If I'm not careful, I might forget some essential accessory.
mem/0031/31/p12: When I went to the common area, I found a note from Takeru Totsuka.
mem/0031/31/p13: This is a regular occurrence. He worries about me coming home late and leaves messages.
mem/0031/31/p15: "Since the cafeteria isn't open yet, I can't do that."
mem/0031/31/p16: I wrote a reply in the blank space on the note and left the dorm.
mem/0031/31/p17: The moon was sinking slightly, and I headed toward the academy while gazing at the brightening sky.
mem/0031/31/p20: There was no one in the classroom.
mem/0031/31/p21: By that measure, the mission was a success. Arriving earlier than anyone else is a step toward achieving the objective.
mem/0031/31/p22: "But... I have no idea when people will arrive. What should I do in the meantime?"
mem/0031/31/p23: If someone were to arrive while I was away from the classroom, I wouldn't be able to confirm it accurately.
mem/0031/31/p24: "I suppose I have no choice but to wait."
mem/0031/31/p25: To avoid any unexpected incidents, I decided to read the discipline section in the student handbook while waiting.
mem/0031/31/p28: The discipline section is short, and I've already repeated it 250 times.
mem/0031/31/p29: With nothing else to do, my consciousness began to fade.
mem/0031/31/p31: Time without a purpose is boring, and even staying awake becomes a chore.
mem/0031/31/p34: I jolted upright at the loud noise.
mem/0031/31/p36: It seems I dozed off and bumped my head against the desk.
mem/0031/31/p37: I rubbed my forehead to ease the spreading ache.
mem/0031/31/p39: I stared at the brightening sky, waiting for the classroom door to open.
mem/0031/31/p40: A considerable amount of time passed. By the time I had memorized the discipline rules perfectly, I heard footsteps.
mem/0031/31/p41: Immediately after, Kusanagi {NAME} appeared in the classroom. As a discipline committee member, I straightened my posture to set a good example, stood up, and called out to her.
mem/0032/32/p0: Walking outside with Kusanagi {NAME} to look for pampas grass.
mem/0032/32/p2: I don't know what use her questions are, but she keeps talking to me regularly.
mem/0032/32/p3: And then she reacts to my answers.
mem/0032/32/p4: I use that to judge whether my remarks were appropriate.
mem/0032/32/p5: I went through that cycle over and over again.
mem/0032/32/p6: Why are questions unrelated to the purpose necessary?
mem/0032/32/p7: I gradually began to wonder about that.
mem/0032/32/p8: She is intelligent, so her actions must have some meaning.
mem/0032/32/p9: Before I knew it, we had left the forest and emerged by an open riverbank. I carefully scanned the surroundings.
mem/0032/32/p10: Recalling the pampas grass I had read about in books, I searched for places where it might grow.
mem/0032/32/p15: She seemed to spot the pampas grass too, turning back to confirm that it was indeed the right plant.
mem/0032/32/p17: With that, she showed me a smile.
mem/0032/32/p18: I was surprised by her words and actions.
mem/0032/32/p20: I hadn't done anything special. I had simply followed her. She was the one who led me here.
mem/0032/32/p21: Why was she thanking me? Why was she smiling with such joy?
mem/0032/32/p22: Doubts began to well up within me.
mem/0032/32/p23: I had never harbored such doubts before, so I could only guess at the reason, but perhaps it was because she was a girl that I became so curious.
mem/0032/32/p24: Because I couldn't take my eyes off her smile.
mem/0032/32/p25: A sensation akin to a quiet rustling spread through my body.
mem/0032/32/p26: I couldn't understand what she was thinking.
mem/0032/32/p27: I just wanted to know the reason for her smile.
mem/0033/33/p0: Tsukito's enthusiasm for the Tsukitsuki festival was truly impressive.
mem/0033/33/p1: Usually, he only did what he was told, with no personal feelings involved.
mem/0033/33/p2: There might have been a sense of right or wrong, but his emotions never overrode that... yet...
mem/0033/33/p3: Even when requests for the stage came in, he didn't voice them, but he seemed to be desperately thinking about how to make them possible.
mem/0033/33/p4: His appearance and actions hadn't changed, but just having Tsukito's heart behind them made him look so different. I was amazed.
mem/0033/33/p5: That's why I decided not to take the lead this time, but to help him instead.
mem/0033/33/p6: "Tsukitsuki~ Tsukitsuki~. We're getting a flood of requests for stage performances. What should we do? Should we draw lots, or just pick them ourselves?"
mem/0033/33/p7: "First, please make a list of those who wish to perform. Also, please prepare the stage details."
mem/0033/33/p8: "Understood. Even if we draw lots, it's important to organize everything."
mem/0033/33/p10: "Eh?! All of it? You're doing it all? That's quite a number, you know?"
mem/0033/33/p11: "It might be possible with some ingenuity. If there's a chance, it's worth trying."
mem/0033/33/p12: If it were me, I'd probably give up the moment I saw that stack of applications. He's amazing.
mem/0033/33/p13: "Tsukito, you're amazing, amazing!! Let's do our best! Let's do our best!"
mem/0033/33/p14: Overjoyed, I cheer for Tsukito with all my might.
mem/0033/33/p15: "More importantly, Apollon Agana Berea, are you finished with your work?"
mem/0033/33/p17: Actually, I'm nowhere near finished. I haven't even reached half the amount I promised Tsukito. How did he know?
mem/0033/33/p18: "Please return to your work immediately after confirming. We don't have much time."
mem/0033/33/p20: There's something strangely imposing about him when he's so motivated.
mem/0033/33/p21: "Ah, there you are, Agana Berea. I've been looking for you."
mem/0033/33/p22: Balder, my work partner, slowly makes his way over from a distance.
mem/0033/33/p23: He's carrying so many things in his arms that he can barely see in front of him.
mem/0033/33/p24: It's fine since Balder is strong... but...
mem/0033/33/p25: "I have to do my best to live up to Totsuka-san's enthusiasm... t-to-to-to."
mem/0033/33/p28: At that moment, he took a spectacular tumble, scattering the things he was carrying everywhere.
mem/0033/33/p29: "Oh dear... are you okay? Are you alright?"
mem/0033/33/p30: I took Balder's hand, buried under the pile of items, and pulled him up.
mem/0033/33/p31: Meanwhile, Tsukito was efficiently tidying things up.
mem/0033/33/p32: "Please don't push yourself too hard, Balder Flinghorni. It would be pointless if you got hurt."
mem/0033/33/p33: "That's right, I'm sorry. I've caused you trouble. I'm probably just in the way."
mem/0033/33/p34: "No, that's not it. No one in this group can be absent. We must succeed in this project at all costs."
mem/0033/33/p35: With that said, Tsukito clenched his fists in front of his chest.
mem/0033/33/p38: Despite being surprised again by his unusual reaction, I felt that the festival would surely go well.
mem/0033/33/p39: Let's do our best together, Tsukito!
mem/0034/34/p0: Today, I have a study date with Totsuka in his room.
mem/0034/34/p1: Totsuka requested a location other than the classroom, saying it would feel more like a couple's outing.
mem/0034/34/p2: When I was invited into the room, I found Takeru there, playing around with Usamaro.
mem/0034/34/p3: "Huh? Why are you here, of all people?"
mem/0034/34/p4: I get a sharp, piercing glare.
mem/0034/34/p6: I had assumed Totsuka had already told him, so I was surprised myself.
mem/0034/34/p7: "I invited him. To study just the two of us."
mem/0034/34/p8: He explains while placing the materials on the desk. It would have been nice if he had done this beforehand, though...
mem/0034/34/p9: I sit down on the chair, mindful of Takeru's gaze.
mem/0034/34/p10: Then, Usamaro hops over to my feet and rubs his body against my leg as if to greet me.
mem/0034/34/p12: When I speak to him, he jumps up happily. He turns back to look at me and hops off toward somewhere.
mem/0034/34/p14: Following his gaze, I see a stuffed rabbit prize from the shooting gallery displayed there.
mem/0034/34/p15: Placed side by side, it's clear how much it resembles Usamaro. Usamaro is also playing with the stuffed animal, looking quite pleased.
mem/0034/34/p17: He got it for me, but it looked so much like Usamaro that I just wanted to give it to him.
mem/0034/34/p18: Handing the stuffed animal to Totsuka was the right call.
mem/0034/34/p20: "Family... is it? Indeed, while they both take the form of a rabbit, they share the commonality of not being alive."
mem/0034/34/p21: Totsuka seems bothered by the word 'family,' muttering to himself.
mem/0034/34/p22: "However, there is no connection other than their shape at this point. It still feels insufficient to call them family."
mem/0034/34/p23: "Then, what if you gave the stuffed animal a name? That would strengthen your bond."
mem/0034/34/p24: "A name... Indeed, sharing a name might be something characteristic of a family."
mem/0034/34/p25: "What name do you think would suit you, Totsuka-san?"
mem/0034/34/p26: I think it's progress that he shows interest in anything I say. Takeru seems to agree, nodding along as he waits for Tsukito's response.
mem/0034/34/p29: Takeru and I spoke the same words at the exact same time.
mem/0034/34/p30: "Tsu is fine too. It becomes that in English."
mem/0034/34/p34: "No, it's not like I can't accept it..."
mem/0034/34/p35: "If we use this method, we can handle it even if the family grows. We won't have to worry about being unsure each time."
mem/0034/34/p37: If we name them mechanically like that, I feel like the meaning behind the names would be lost.
mem/0034/34/p38: "By the way, this smaller one is Usamaro 3."
mem/0034/34/p40: "Hey, that sounds like it has a different meaning."
mem/0034/34/p41: "Yes, it feels like Usamaro has become quite important."
mem/0034/34/p42: Tsukito looks at us with a puzzled expression, as if he doesn't quite understand our conversation.
mem/0034/34/p44: "Well, let's take our time thinking about it. Besides, I don't dislike your way of thinking, Yui. I just find it a bit hard to say."
mem/0034/34/p45: "It is true that using numbers in names is common. In the case of humans, it often indicates birth order, like Jiro, Saburo, or Shiro."
mem/0034/34/p47: "Oh, that sounds like a great name!"
mem/0034/34/p48: Usamaro seems eager to join the conversation, hopping around in circles.
mem/0034/34/p50: And so, we got excited, and the naming meeting for our new family of three people and one bird continued late into the night.
mem/0034/34/p51: That time felt just like a family's, warm and comfortable.
mem/0035/35/p0: Every time Anii is kind to me, I remember the past.
mem/0035/35/p1: I had become so unruly that I was beyond control after a certain incident.
mem/0035/35/p3: Whenever our eyes met, I would glare at anyone, regardless of who they were. None of the gods around me dared to approach me.
mem/0035/35/p4: I didn't want to get close to anyone either, and I had lost faith in everything.
mem/0035/35/p5: I grew furious at this situation and threw tantrums, but everyone ignored me as if I didn't even exist.
mem/0035/35/p6: Even my eldest brother, Amaterasu, only looked at me with concern and ultimately remained an onlooker, just like the others.
mem/0035/35/p7: No one understood me. I was someone who didn't matter.
mem/0035/35/p8: At that time, I thought that even Anii had no interest in me, just like the others.
mem/0035/35/p9: With that thought, I spent a long time in solitude.
mem/0035/35/p11: Without saying a word, he reached out his hand toward me.
mem/0035/35/p12: It was just that simple gesture.
mem/0035/35/p13: I thought he was mocking me at first, and it made me angry, but when I looked into Anii's eyes, my mind changed.
mem/0035/35/p14: He was just staring at me with those sincere, unclouded eyes. There was no contempt or curiosity in them; he was looking right at me.
mem/0035/35/p15: It felt as if something deep inside my heart had been firmly grasped.
mem/0035/35/p16: I reached out my hand almost as if I were being pulled in, without even realizing it.
mem/0035/35/p17: Our fingers touched, and I gripped his hand tightly.
mem/0035/35/p18: How long had it been since I last touched someone? I couldn't even remember, but as that distant memory surfaced, I felt the warmth of his palm.
mem/0035/35/p20: I noticed tears slipping from my eyes.
mem/0035/35/p21: I had meant to say 'Onii,' but the last words were swallowed by my tears and vanished.
mem/0035/35/p22: I realized just how desperately I had been craving warmth.
mem/0035/35/p23: I had been putting on a brave face, but in truth, I just wanted to be with someone.
mem/0035/35/p24: Since then, I've been with Anii all the time. Or rather, it might be more accurate to say he lets me stay by his side.
mem/0035/35/p25: After all, I want to be by Anii's side.
mem/0035/35/p26: His words and actions may seem blunt, but I love Anii, who is actually very kind.
mem/0035/35/p27: I will never forget the warmth that saved me back then.
mem/0036/36/p2: I do have a family, but I've never felt any love from them.
mem/0036/36/p3: Takeru seems to admire me, but I don't think I deserve to accept that admiration.
mem/0036/36/p4: The feelings Takeru has for me are like an illusion.
mem/0036/36/p5: And I read somewhere that love cannot exist if it is one-sided. It only gains meaning when given and received mutually.
mem/0036/36/p6: Even people who have spent years together find it difficult, yet she says it as if it were something simple.
mem/0036/36/p7: Even though I thought that way in my head, strangely, a warmth spread deep within my chest.
mem/0036/36/p9: It felt like a light had been lit in the darkness... a soft, gentle glow that brought a sense of relief.
mem/0036/36/p10: That warmth spread through my entire body, not just my heart.
mem/0036/36/p11: I couldn't stop it on my own. It kept welling up from within.
mem/0036/36/p13: Is this what it means to be happy?
mem/0036/36/p15: As I was tossed about by those waves, she peeked at my face with concern.
mem/0036/36/p16: My heart stirred at that sight. My whole body jumped with a thud.
mem/0036/36/p17: I want to be her family too.
mem/0036/36/p19: I wanted to tell her my feelings quickly, but I didn't know how.
mem/0036/36/p21: With my current self, I couldn't express it with any words beyond that.
mem/0036/36/p22: I wanted to convey this feeling, even just a little. With that thought, I opened my mouth.
mem/0036/36/p24: At that moment, I was smiling. True to my heart...
mem/0037/37/p0: The manual didn't specify how to feel.
mem/0037/37/p1: It only told me what actions to take and what words to say, but nothing beyond that.
mem/0037/37/p2: Before I knew it, I was doing things not written in the manual.
mem/0037/37/p3: Normally, someone who knows nothing like me should follow the manual.
mem/0037/37/p4: I thought I understood that, but my body started acting differently.
mem/0037/37/p5: Following my own heart, not the manual.
mem/0037/37/p6: Without asking for her permission, I hugged her from behind.
mem/0037/37/p9: That reaction was natural. I was surprised by myself too, so she must have been even more shocked by the ambush.
mem/0037/37/p10: "Is it alright if we stay like this for a while? I think you'll want to go home if you get cold..."
mem/0037/37/p11: While worrying about her state, I realized I might just want to do this for myself.
mem/0037/37/p13: Of course, there's a fear that I might give her a cold, and I do intend to prevent that.
mem/0037/37/p14: However, to avoid that risk, I could simply leave this place quickly and move to a warm spot.
mem/0037/37/p15: Even understanding that, another emotion wanting to stay like this was controlling me.
mem/0037/37/p16: I tightened my arms around her shoulders.
mem/0037/37/p17: "...I'd like it to stay like this forever."
mem/0037/37/p18: As if responding to my movement, she answered.
mem/0037/37/p19: My heart leaped at the thought that we were thinking the same thing.
mem/0037/37/p23: Even if it was just a coincidence that we thought the same thing, just that makes me feel happy.
mem/0037/37/p24: And I want to touch her even more. I didn't know I had feelings like this inside me.
mem/0037/37/p25: I wanted to feel her, so I held her even tighter.
mem/0037/37/p26: I held onto the hope that we could stay like this for just a little while longer.
mem/0038/38/p0: Even before coming to the academy, he had looked up to his inept older brother.
mem/0038/38/p1: I, who didn't even understand myself, had nothing to give him. I had simply accepted his kindness unilaterally.
mem/0038/38/p2: I didn't know how to respond to that, so I couldn't even give him an answer.
mem/0038/38/p3: Of course, even after coming to the academy, we became roommates. He always kept an eye on me and taught me various things.
mem/0038/38/p4: Whether I had eaten, if I had forgotten anything, if I was sleeping properly.
mem/0038/38/p5: The list goes on and on.
mem/0038/38/p6: It started with small things, but eventually extended to every aspect of my life.
mem/0038/38/p7: And he even protested to Takeru Totsuka to protect me.
mem/0038/38/p8: And yet, I destroyed all of that with my own hands.
mem/0038/38/p9: It wasn't until Takeru Totsuka disappeared that I finally realized how big his presence was.
mem/0038/38/p10: If only it were possible, I want to spend time with Takeru Totsuka like we used to.
mem/0038/38/p11: My heart was screaming that wish.
mem/0038/38/p12: Even though it's already too late...
mem/0038/38/p13: As I explained his disappearance to Apollon, Agana, and Berea, I felt my vision going dark.
mem/0038/38/p14: I don't know what I should do.
mem/0038/38/p15: "I see, I see. So, Tsukitsuki wants to make up, does he?"
mem/0038/38/p18: Of course, thinking about it won't give me an answer. Takeru Totsuka is the one who decides that.
mem/0038/38/p19: Just sitting here won't start anything.
mem/0038/38/p20: That's why I have to see him. I need to meet him and make sure.
mem/0038/38/p21: This time, it's my turn to go and get him.
mem/0039/39/t: I Want to Be Near You
mem/0039/39/p0: I watched her until she disappeared from view.
mem/0039/39/p1: I etched her silhouette into my memory so I wouldn't forget it.
mem/0039/39/p3: I probably won't be able to fulfill those words I said myself.
mem/0039/39/p4: So, I just wanted to feel her presence for as long as possible.
mem/0039/39/p5: We graduated from the academy safely, and he and I returned to our proper worlds. I spend my days fulfilling my duties as the Moon God.
mem/0039/39/p6: Yet, whenever I look at the moon, all I remember is her retreating figure and the tears she shed at the end.
mem/0039/39/p7: Even though I want to erase her sorrow, there is nothing I can do for her now.
mem/0039/39/p8: All I can do is recall the time we spent together and pray that she remains smiling.
mem/0039/39/p9: The moon sets, and time moves on.
mem/0039/39/p10: Time seemed to crawl by slowly, as if it had stopped entirely.
mem/0039/39/p11: In the past, I never would have felt that passage of time to be so long.
mem/0039/39/p13: I don't want to send you back to your world.
mem/0039/39/p14: If I had stopped her, would the outcome have been different?
mem/0039/39/p16: I press a hand to my chest, overcome by a heart-wrenching ache.
mem/0039/39/p17: "I want to stay by your side."
mem/0039/39/p18: Could I endure spending time that feels almost eternal without her? Just thinking about it makes my head spin.
mem/0039/39/p19: "I can't imagine a life without you."
mem/0039/39/p20: The emotions she gave me now torment me.
mem/0039/39/p22: No matter what difficulties await, I am willing to sacrifice anything.
mem/0039/39/p23: I desperately wanted to fulfill that promise.
mem/0039/39/p24: Going to the human world to see her was fraught with difficulty.
mem/0039/39/p25: Yet, the urge to see her drove me forward.
mem/0039/39/p26: And how much time had passed since then?
mem/0039/39/p27: Amidst the falling cherry blossoms, I spotted her. She stood there, unchanged from the day we first met.
mem/0039/39/p29: When I called her name, she turned around and looked at me in surprise.
mem/0039/39/p31: I could tell from her expression that she seemed to have forgotten me.
mem/0039/39/p33: Even though I knew her memories had been erased, a part of me had still hoped.
mem/0039/39/p34: "I've wanted to see you for so long."
mem/0039/39/p35: But my face naturally breaks into a smile at the joy of finally meeting her. This, too, is an emotion she gave me.
mem/0039/39/p36: Even if she's forgotten me, I'll make her remember.
mem/0039/39/p37: That's because I have feelings I want to convey to her...
mem/0040/40/p0: In the mythological world where eternal time flows.
mem/0040/40/p1: I never imagined she would come to our world.
mem/0040/40/p2: I had never even considered acting alongside someone else.
mem/0040/40/p3: Because I, who find it difficult to understand myself, thought I would never have deep connections with others.
mem/0040/40/p4: She taught me that conversing and touching someone could bring such joy.
mem/0040/40/p5: However, I cannot act as boldly as I did when we first met at the academy.
mem/0040/40/p6: Looking back now, it's strange that I could do such things so casually back then.
mem/0040/40/p7: Kisses, embraces, and even lap pillows...
mem/0040/40/p8: I suppose I could only do those things because I didn't know any better.
mem/0040/40/p9: When I wasn't conscious of it, pressing my lips against hers felt no different from skin touching skin.
mem/0040/40/p10: Perhaps I should say it's like holding an object in my hand.
mem/0040/40/p11: Now, even just holding hands makes my heart pound so hard it hurts.
mem/0040/40/p12: I worry that she might notice my overly rapid heartbeat through our interlaced fingers.
mem/0040/40/p13: It seems my body is being tossed about by these unfamiliar sensations now that I, who was once insensitive, have begun to feel emotions.
mem/0040/40/p14: Even now, as I try to gather my thoughts, my awareness focuses on the parts of me touching her, making it hard to calm down.
mem/0040/40/p16: She peers at my face with concern.
mem/0040/40/p17: Our distance is close. She leans her body against my arm, fitting perfectly.
mem/0040/40/p18: The sight is so incredibly adorable. I can feel through my eyes that she adores me.
mem/0040/40/p19: "I feel like I'm having trouble breathing from the nervousness."
mem/0040/40/p20: That is how I convey the truth.
mem/0040/40/p21: I recently learned that when happiness becomes excessive, it can become painful.
mem/0040/40/p22: I suppose this is what they call a 'joyful scream' in human literature.
mem/0040/40/p24: My words cause her to blush deeply all at once.
mem/0040/40/p25: Was my expression too exaggerated? Or did she take the phrase 'breathless' seriously and is worried about me?
mem/0040/40/p26: If it's the latter, I'm still glad.
mem/0040/40/p27: However, if it's the former, there's a chance she hasn't realized that it's true.
mem/0040/40/p28: "Even so, I'm shy. You are someone very precious and dear to me."
mem/0040/40/p29: I added a more careful explanation.
mem/0040/40/p30: I strongly want to convey my true feelings. I'm not good at it yet, but I hope my love for her reaches her, even a little.
mem/0040/40/p31: She blushes even more at my words.
mem/0040/40/p32: I'm sure I'm blushing just as much as she is.
mem/0040/40/p33: I felt as if our hearts and bodies were connected, and I couldn't help but smile naturally.
mem/0041/41/p1: It's been quite a while since I started looking for shell materials by the seaside, but it's not easy to find ones with the same shape.
mem/0041/41/p2: There is no such thing as two identical things created by nature.
mem/0041/41/p3: Especially with shells, the patterns and colors differ, and they often have chips or imperfections, making it difficult to find one with a perfect shape.
mem/0041/41/p4: "I found two that were pretty close... but without a third, it's pointless."
mem/0041/41/p5: I need three. There's no way I'm compromising on that.
mem/0041/41/p6: A proof of our sibling bond connecting Amaterasu, my brother, and me.
mem/0041/41/p7: Of course, I believe our hearts are connected.
mem/0041/41/p8: I thought it would be nice to have something visible, so I decided to make matching pendants.
mem/0041/41/p9: When I learned that the start of my bond with my brother was just a coincidence, I didn't know what to do.
mem/0041/41/p11: That despair made me feel like everything was crumbling.
mem/0041/41/p12: What really got to me wasn't the fact that it started by chance or that we aren't blood-related.
mem/0041/41/p13: I was scared that all the time my brother and I had spent together would be rendered meaningless.
mem/0041/41/p14: I was just so sad, wondering if it was all my misunderstanding, if my brother felt nothing for me.
mem/0041/41/p15: But my brother chased after me and desperately tried to convey his feelings.
mem/0041/41/p16: It was all awkward words, but they were filled with his true feelings.
mem/0041/41/p17: My brother, who is bad at expressing his feelings.
mem/0041/41/p18: Seeing him like that, I wondered why I was getting angry.
mem/0041/41/p19: The warmth when he reached out his hand was real, and the fact that his presence had always supported me was a truth.
mem/0041/41/p21: Thinking that, my heart suddenly felt lighter.
mem/0041/41/p22: Nothing has changed. Whether we are blood-related or not, the relationship we've built won't break.
mem/0041/41/p23: Rather, I think we've become even stronger by overcoming a huge wall. Because there's nothing better than this.
mem/0041/41/p24: And then there's my other brother, Amaterasu.
mem/0041/41/p25: I used to think he was a total jerk, but I was just surprised to learn that we'd just been misunderstanding each other and that he was actually looking out for me more than anyone else.
mem/0041/41/p26: I wonder why we didn't talk things over sooner.
mem/0041/41/p27: Amaterasu hated and envied his brother, I hated Amaterasu for that, and his brother held back and avoided me because we weren't blood-related.
mem/0041/41/p28: It's crazy how a relationship can get so strained just because two people are thinking of each other but looking in different directions.
mem/0041/41/p29: "Huh? ...Oh, this is nice! It feels very Amaterasu-like."
mem/0041/41/p30: I picked up a beautifully shining seashell and brushed off the sand.
mem/0041/41/p31: "I finally found it... I need to take good care of this."
mem/0041/41/p32: I poured my feelings into the seashell.
mem/0041/41/p33: So I wouldn't forget how I feel right now.
mem/0041/41/p34: So that whenever I look at it, I'll remember that the three of us are always connected.
mem/0042/42/p0: One afternoon, as graduation drew near.
mem/0042/42/p1: Takeru and I were relaxing on a mat spread out in the courtyard.
mem/0042/42/p2: Worried that I don't go outside much, Takeru occasionally drags me out like this.
mem/0042/42/p3: "Bro, wanna eat some manju? They're delicious, you know?"
mem/0042/42/p4: He's holding a large manju in his hand and offering me the half he's already broken off.
mem/0042/42/p5: "I don't need it right now. I'm full."
mem/0042/42/p8: He keeps trying to force me to eat.
mem/0042/42/p9: "You don't eat much, nii. You don't have to hold back."
mem/0042/42/p10: He made a slightly disappointed face and started munching on the half of the manju he'd saved for me.
mem/0042/42/p11: Was this one of those situations where I wasn't supposed to refuse?
mem/0042/42/p12: I noticed from Takeru's expression, but it was already too late. I'd missed my chance.
mem/0042/42/p14: "So, Totsuka You, you've come to the academy."
mem/0042/42/p15: With an elegant, flowing motion, he adjusted his kimono and sat down on the mat where we were seated.
mem/0042/42/p17: Takeru snorted but held out the half of the manju he was holding.
mem/0042/42/p18: "Can't you come visit without a reason, brother?"
mem/0042/42/p19: You gently accepted the offering on a plate and brought the manju to his mouth.
mem/0042/42/p20: Manju doesn't suit him. But judging by how he eats it, it seems to be a food he likes.
mem/0042/42/p21: There's still so much I don't know about him.
mem/0042/42/p22: "Don't say things like that. ...If I don't know in advance, I can't prepare yours."
mem/0042/42/p23: He turned his head away, hiding his embarrassment as he stuffed the manju into his mouth.
mem/0042/42/p24: "So that's what you call being uncooperative... I learn something new every day."
mem/0042/42/p25: Since coming to this academy, my understanding of my own emotions has deepened, but there's still a lot I'm feeling my way through.
mem/0042/42/p26: Right now, I want to confirm things little by little and make them my own.
mem/0042/42/p27: "Tsukito has become quite talkative. And he smiles more often now."
mem/0042/42/p29: "At least to me, you look happy."
mem/0042/42/p30: Hearing that, my chest warms up all at once. Someone's words or actions actually bring about a change in me.
mem/0042/42/p31: It feels so good right now that I can't help it.
mem/0042/42/p32: "But if I hadn't come to this academy, we might never have had the chance to drink tea together like this."
mem/0042/42/p33: Takeru's profile, gazing into the distance, seemed to be recalling our past.
mem/0042/42/p34: "I suppose I owe thanks to Zeus for giving me this opportunity, and to Kusanagi {NAME} for connecting us."
mem/0042/42/p35: They all felt the same way.
mem/0042/42/p36: Is it because we're siblings that I can tell without him saying a word?
mem/0042/42/p40: "You've got red bean paste on your mouth."
mem/0042/42/p41: A small black dot sits just below the lower right corner of his lips. It looks like a mole, and the sight makes me feel a sudden urge to laugh.
mem/0042/42/p44: Even the gesture of wiping it away is the same.
mem/0042/42/p45: We looked at each other and smiled.
mem/0043/43/p0: Today was my day off, and I had already made plans with {NAME} to go out together.
mem/0043/43/p1: I was looking forward to it, and so was she.
mem/0043/43/p2: But on the day itself, when I woke up, it was raining outside.
mem/0043/43/p3: I immediately got an email. We quickly changed our plans and decided to spend the day at her room instead.
mem/0043/43/p4: 2:30 PM. I arrived at her room.
mem/0043/43/p6: I handed her a cake I bought from a patisserie as a housewarming present.
mem/0043/43/p7: I'm not particularly interested in food, but I started buying treats like this whenever I could, just to see her reaction.
mem/0043/43/p8: She smiled brightly, saying she was looking forward to opening it.
mem/0043/43/p9: Inside was an assortment of small cakes. I figured I'd get another reaction when she opened the box.
mem/0043/43/p10: "And this. It's the compilation album you said you wanted to hear."
mem/0043/43/p11: "Wow, it's the one you mentioned before, Senpai."
mem/0043/43/p12: She said that, her eyes sparkling. Her expressions changed so quickly, it was amusing.
mem/0043/43/p14: "I arranged tracks 3 and 4... and actually, I secretly did backing vocals for one song. It was a last-minute addition, so I didn't list it in the booklet on purpose."
mem/0043/43/p16: "I'll keep the track number a secret. Try to guess."
mem/0043/43/p17: She looked determined to figure it out.
mem/0043/43/p18: "Can I listen to it right away?"
mem/0043/43/p20: We spent the rest of the time relaxing.
mem/0043/43/p21: She sat on the rug laid out on the floor, listening to the music and eagerly reading the CD booklet.
mem/0043/43/p22: I sat on the sofa and looked through the magazine she had brought me.
mem/0043/43/p23: It was a valuable source of information for me to learn what she usually reads.
mem/0043/43/p24: The magazine featured a special on 'cute little dogs.'
mem/0043/43/p25: It was the kind of content that Natsuki would absolutely love.
mem/0043/43/p26: Toy Poodles, Yorkshire Terriers, Maltese, and Miniature Schnauzers. Photos of these fluffy, round balls of fur filled the pages.
mem/0043/43/p27: I still didn't fully grasp the concept of 'cute,' but I had a vague idea that these fell into that category.
mem/0043/43/p28: But this dog with a long snout and long white fur... I feel like I've seen it somewhere before. Does it count as 'cute' too?
mem/0043/43/p31: Instead of asking what was wrong, I turned my head, and she turned back to look at me with a strangely proud expression.
mem/0043/43/p32: The CD had just reached track 8.
mem/0043/43/p33: Ah, she must have recognized my voice from the backing vocals.
mem/0043/43/p34: As a Song Robot, I have a wide vocal range. This time, I tried singing quite differently from usual, aiming to challenge myself...
mem/0043/43/p35: I nodded instead of praising her for noticing, and she smiled happily.
mem/0043/43/p36: It's kind of... dog-like, I think. Comparing it to the magazine, I've heard that dogs are serious animals, so maybe there's a resemblance.
mem/0043/43/p37: But this is much more interesting than the motionless dogs in the magazine. I put down the magazine and began observing her from the sofa.
mem/0043/43/p38: By the time the CD had played through twice, she took out a notebook and started jotting down notes about the songs. Probably for reference when trying new expressions.
mem/0043/43/p39: When it comes to music, she shows incredible concentration. But otherwise, she's a bit slow. It's like most of her brain is dedicated to music.
mem/0043/43/p40: That kind of imbalance is also interesting.
mem/0043/43/p43: "No... just keep going as you are."
mem/0043/43/p44: Even while tilting her head in confusion, she returned to her work.
mem/0043/43/p45: Thinking back, there were all sorts of things during the movie shoot, too. Like getting attacked by crows for no reason on location. (The cause turned out to be the hat she was wearing.)
mem/0043/43/p46: Or when Shou and Natsuki's NG scenes hit their funny bone perfectly, and we couldn't stop laughing for over an hour.
mem/0043/43/p47: On one hand, it was worrying and made me anxious, but on the other, just knowing she was there on set, watching with a smile, gave me an odd sense of comfort.
mem/0043/43/p48: It even made me think, "Maybe I should try harder."
mem/0043/43/p49: On the way back from the Christmas live, Reiji teased me, and I couldn't help but call her my "cute partner." But I don't think that was wrong.
mem/0043/43/p50: Not only does she have an "adorable" vibe and look, but I also want to cherish her smile. I feel like I want to be by her side and protect her.
mem/0043/43/p51: Maybe this is the true nature of the feeling of "cuteness."
mem/0043/43/p53: Before I knew it, she was the one staring at me.
mem/0043/43/p54: "Ah, sorry. I was lost in thought."
mem/0043/43/p56: She tilted her head, then turned an even more serious gaze toward me.
mem/0043/43/p60: I wondered if my face had been that tense, so I pinched my own cheek.
mem/0043/43/p61: "No, this face is my natural one. Sorry for being hard to read."
mem/0043/43/p62: "Hah!! No, I'm the one who should apologize!"
mem/0043/43/p63: She didn't need to be so flustered... I was only joking.
mem/0043/43/p64: Just then, the CD finished its second play and stopped.
mem/0043/43/p65: "It's over. Um, should I go get another CD?"
mem/0043/43/p67: I reached out from the sofa and pressed my hand firmly against her cheek.
mem/0043/43/p70: This time, her eyes widened. I could look at her for hours and never get bored.
mem/0043/43/p72: My words made her cheeks flush bright red, like an apple.
mem/0043/43/p73: "You're just too cute. It throws me off balance."
mem/0043/43/p74: If I had to call it a problem, that would be mine.
mem/0043/43/p75: "W-Why are you saying all this so suddenly?"
mem/0043/43/p76: "I'm not being sudden. I'm just saying what I've been feeling all along."
mem/0043/43/p77: I noticed a smile naturally forming on my lips, and I leaned closer to her.
mem/0043/43/p79: I pulled her entire head toward me, leaving her unable to move.
mem/0043/43/p80: Yeah. It feels right. You really are the most wonderful partner.
mem/0043/43/p81: The rain doesn't seem like it'll stop anytime soon. Let's stay like this for a while longer.
mem/0044/44/p0: "Do you know what 'mixing business with pleasure' means?"
mem/0044/44/p1: "I know. But what does that have to do with our lesson right now?"
mem/0044/44/p2: "It has everything to do with it!!"
mem/0044/44/p3: 10:30 AM. We were in the office conference room.
mem/0044/44/p4: "Why did you bring Kusanagi to the lesson?"
mem/0044/44/p6: My partner. It's a phrase Aoi says at least three times a day lately.
mem/0044/44/p7: "Um, if I'm in the way, I'll leave right away..."
mem/0044/44/p9: It all started about a week ago. Aoi, who had been missing, suddenly returned to us.
mem/0044/44/p11: He severed his connection with Kisaragi Ino and, with the Doctor's help, was reborn as an idol capable of freely expressing his emotions.
mem/0044/44/p12: Aoi came back. That alone made me incredibly happy.
mem/0044/44/p13: But after that, the Doctor made a surprising proposal to us.
mem/0044/44/p14: The 'Reverse Master Course'. Literally, this time we take the role of instructors to train Aoi so he can return to his entertainment activities quickly.
mem/0044/44/p15: Of course, we accepted without hesitation.
mem/0044/44/p16: It's a piece of cake! Just like Aoi used to do for us, we'll drill him hard and beat the idol path into him!
mem/0044/44/p17: ...But our enthusiasm was in vain. In the end, we got swept up in Aoi's pace, and the situation was far from proper instruction.
mem/0044/44/p18: "Anyway, Kusanagi is only accompanying us for today. Got it?"
mem/0044/44/p20: "Understood. Let's start the lesson. We didn't make any progress yesterday at all... Let's start from page 6 of 'Tohru Kurusu's Idol Path'."
mem/0044/44/p21: I took out a homemade manual. Even though I was supposed to teach, I didn't know where to start, so I compiled basic things and what I had learned from Aoi so far into this manual.
mem/0044/44/p25: "This manual is a mess. It's hard to read."
mem/0044/44/p27: "Keep headings simple and on one line. Cut out unnecessary content. Number every page. And if I may, I'd like a table of contents."
mem/0044/44/p29: That would definitely make it easier to read.
mem/0044/44/p30: "Wait, why am I the one getting lectured!"
mem/0044/44/p31: "Also... what are those chick illustrations at the bottom of each page?"
mem/0044/44/p32: "Ah, I drew those. That's Piyochan. Isn't it fun?"
mem/0044/44/p33: Tsukuyomi reached out from the side to touch the manual Ai was holding.
mem/0044/44/p34: "Is this okay? Like this... If I flip through the pages quickly?"
mem/0044/44/p35: "It moves. The chick is flapping around."
mem/0044/44/p36: "Hold on. When did you sneak that in?"
mem/0044/44/p37: I hurriedly flipped through the pages to check. ...Ah, it really does move.
mem/0044/44/p38: "The design isn't bad, but it has nothing to do with the content. This isn't a pop-up book for toddlers."
mem/0044/44/p39: "No, it's not a picture book. It's a flip book."
mem/0044/44/p40: "Stooop! We're not arguing about the manual's appearance anymore!"
mem/0044/44/p41: I stepped in between them to stop the argument. Damn it, I stayed up all night making this.
mem/0044/44/p42: "If you have questions, at least talk about the content!"
mem/0044/44/p44: Aoi flipped through the manual, which was covered in sticky notes.
mem/0044/44/p45: "'First, greet the people on site.' That's so obvious it hardly needs writing down. I already have that basic info memorized, along with common industry terms used on the job and data on the main staff and contacts I've worked with."
mem/0044/44/p47: "And then there's this rare, original entry from Shou, talking about spirit and determination... Isn't that leaning too heavily on mental toughness?"
mem/0044/44/p49: "But... so what? Your way isn't necessarily the right fit for me."
mem/0044/44/p51: Now that I think about it, it probably wasn't exactly the 'guts and spirit!' vibe, at least for Aoi.
mem/0044/44/p53: For some reason, Kusanagi suddenly raised her hand.
mem/0044/44/p55: For some reason, Aoi granted her permission to speak.
mem/0044/44/p56: "Senpai, don't you think you're being a bit too harsh?"
mem/0044/44/p57: Not only us, but even Aoi widened his eyes at Kusanagi, who tilted her head slightly as she said that.
mem/0044/44/p58: "It's true that everything written in the manual isn't necessarily correct. But right now, Shou-kun and Shinonome-san are acting as Aomikaze-senpai's guides, and they're thinking about what's best for him."
mem/0044/44/p59: "So... please listen to their advice first. Determination is important too."
mem/0044/44/p60: Kusanagi... what a nice person to say in a situation like this...!
mem/0044/44/p62: Aoi looked at Kusanagi, then turned to us and bowed his head.
mem/0044/44/p64: "No, I should have taught you better. I didn't express myself clearly enough..."
mem/0044/44/p65: "It's fine, A-chan, Sho-chan. Don't worry about it. Fighting is just proof of how close you are."
mem/0044/44/p67: I stop myself mid-sentence. Well, Tsukito is probably trying to be considerate of the mood in his own way.
mem/0044/44/p68: "By the way, Sensei Sho-chan. I'm hungry, so shall we take a lunch break here?"
mem/0044/44/p70: After that, we went outside for lunch.
mem/0044/44/p71: "I made lunchboxes because I wanted us all to eat together."
mem/0044/44/p73: As soon as we stepped outside, Aoi suggested, 'Let's go to the shrine.'
mem/0044/44/p74: We accepted the proposal, headed to the shrine, and sat down on the small patch of grass beside the grounds.
mem/0044/44/p75: Our shrine, located just a short walk from our office, sits on a hill. Through the thick foliage, you can catch glimpses of the town around our office.
mem/0044/44/p76: Now that I think about it, didn't the four of us come here for our first shrine visit of the New Year?
mem/0044/44/p77: We all drank amazake together here, back then too.
mem/0044/44/p78: Aoi suddenly started saying he wanted to sing a love song. I was surprised.
mem/0044/44/p79: Do you remember? I don't ask, and Aoi doesn't say anything either, but the fact that he suggested going to the shrine means he might be remembering it somewhere in his heart.
mem/0044/44/p80: Kusanagi took a small pot out of her bag and began to unfold it.
mem/0044/44/p81: "I've prepared tea for Bifu-senpai. I thought you might enjoy the aroma alone..."
mem/0044/44/p83: Aoi is honest in front of Kusanagi, just as I thought. It's like their partnership is second nature.
mem/0044/44/p85: At Aoi's question, Tsukiyomi, sitting beside him, leaned in to smell the freshly poured tea.
mem/0044/44/p87: "Correct, Shinonome-san. I started growing them in the garden. I also tried growing thyme, but it seems the scent is a bit too strong when made into tea..."
mem/0044/44/p88: "Thyme is good for the throat. It has antibacterial properties, and gargling with it makes you feel refreshed when your throat hurts."
mem/0044/44/p90: Aoi smiled warmly, holding his teacup.
mem/0044/44/p91: Well, this wasn't so bad. Maybe it was an option to let Kusanagi handle things for a while.
mem/0044/44/p92: "Come on, {NAME}. You can't eat if you don't open your mouth."
mem/0044/44/p93: "No, Senpai, everyone else is here too...!"
mem/0044/44/p95: "Oh, come on... What are you doing while I wasn't looking?"
mem/0044/44/p96: "What do you mean? Her hands are full, so I'm just feeding her for her."
mem/0044/44/p97: Aoi held a crab-shaped sausage with his chopsticks, bringing it close to Kusanagi's mouth.
mem/0044/44/p98: He said it was out of kindness, but to anyone else, it just looked like a couple being affectionate.
mem/0044/44/p99: I slammed open the manual and shoved it at Aoi.
mem/0044/44/p100: "Kurusu Sho's Idol Path, Part 6: 'An idol must not be distracted by love!'"
mem/0044/44/p102: "Kurusu Sho's Idol Path, Part 7: 'Partnership is important!' That's right, isn't it?"
mem/0044/44/p103: Of course, that's what I meant.
mem/0044/44/p104: After feeding Kusanagi the sausage, Aoi reached into the bento box with his chopsticks and picked up another sausage.
mem/0044/44/p105: "Fine, fine. If you're going to be so persistent, I'll give some to Sho. Here, open wide. Here you go."
mem/0044/44/p106: The sausage was shoved right into my mouth with a squishy thud.
mem/0044/44/p107: "W-what, you idiot! Seriously, compared to how you fed Kusanagi, this is way too rough!"
mem/0044/44/p108: "In that case, I can do it too. Here, Sho-chan. Let's say 'ahh'."
mem/0044/44/p109: This time, an onigiri was pressed against my mouth with forceful shoves. Despite their reputation for brute strength, they held nothing back. No mercy... absolutely no mercy!
mem/0044/44/p110: "Hehe. I have tamagoyaki over here too."
mem/0044/44/p112: He calls himself the 'New Bifrost Aoi,' but honestly, he's still as lacking in charm as ever.
mem/0044/44/p113: Natsuki doesn't listen to anyone, and while Kusanagi is a good guy, he's a bit spaced out.
mem/0044/44/p114: But this is just right. Somehow, I'm having a really good time right now. That's what I think.
mem/0044/44/p115: Our daily lives haven't changed, then or now.
mem/0045/45/p0: Once he spoke, he would turn into bubbles and fade away, destined to disappear. Yet, he still sang.
mem/0045/45/p1: Now I understand clearly. Why the mermaid prince sang that song back then.
mem/0045/45/p2: I was happy. I could stay with the one I loved until the very end, and I could finish singing the precious song we created together.
mem/0045/45/p3: Where I ended up after my functions ceased was the sea.
mem/0045/45/p4: Before me stretched the endless ocean. And the horizon.
mem/0045/45/p5: Behind me lay the endless sandy beach. And the edge of the world.
mem/0045/45/p6: I remember. This is the sea where I met Aine when I disconnected from Aine. Why did I come back here?
mem/0045/45/p7: But unlike that time, the sky and sea weren't monochrome; they were a single shade of white. The brightness was so intense it blinded me.
mem/0045/45/p8: I sat down on the sandy beach. In this world of pure white, even the boundary between sea and land was indistinct.
mem/0045/45/p9: Well, never mind. I'm a bit tired, so I'll rest here for a while.
mem/0045/45/p10: Then, with nothing else to do, I began to recall everything that had happened, one memory at a time.
mem/0045/45/p11: I woke up as a robot, met my creator, and was trained to be a specialist in singing.
mem/0045/45/p12: I met Shining, became an idol, and met everyone at the agency. As I got to know people, there were more troubles and things to learn, but every day was new and exciting.
mem/0045/45/p13: Then I met my juniors at the Master Course, and we lived our days in a constant uproar...
mem/0045/45/p14: Just when I thought it was finally over, Shining called me out again... and I met {NAME}.
mem/0045/45/p15: Thinking back, I feel like I was quite blunt when I first met her. I hurt her with my thoughtless words.
mem/0045/45/p16: I feel like I didn't apologize properly. I'm sorry.
mem/0045/45/p17: As a song robot, I thought I had no choice but to fulfill the role I was given.
mem/0045/45/p18: But... that wasn't true. She taught me so many feelings.
mem/0045/45/p19: The feeling of joy. The feeling of sadness. The feeling of worry. The feeling of envy. And then...
mem/0045/45/p20: {NAME}. You taught me what love is.
mem/0045/45/p21: We created music together. We studied acting together. We rode the Ferris wheel together. It wasn't very long, but we spent irreplaceable time together.
mem/0045/45/p22: A clumsy, scatterbrained, but gentle girl who loved music.
mem/0045/45/p23: Because you were always watching me, I was able to stand on stage. I was able to sing until the very end.
mem/0045/45/p25: If I could, I would have wanted to stay with her longer.
mem/0045/45/p26: I wonder how she is doing now. Is she crying alone? Is she doing okay? I'm still... worried.
mem/0045/45/p27: A single drop fell from my eyes. Did this body of mine even have a 'crying' function?
mem/0045/45/p28: It only makes me sadder to realize that this place is truly a world without you.
mem/0045/45/p29: In this pure white world, I couldn't even tell where the sun was. There was no sign of morning or night coming.
mem/0045/45/p30: I spent a very long time just like that.
mem/0045/45/p31: Splash. I wake up to the sound of water.
mem/0045/45/p32: Had I been asleep? My head feels hazy.
mem/0045/45/p35: I lifted my face from my knees and saw a human figure before me.
mem/0045/45/p36: He stood in the sea, looking straight at me.
mem/0045/45/p38: The world, which was supposed to be all white, was tinged with blue around Aine.
mem/0045/45/p39: "If you can see my form now, then you are truly lucky."
mem/0045/45/p40: Every time Aine spoke, the blue color spread into the white sea like ripples on water.
mem/0045/45/p45: "That's why I was able to come up from the bottom of the dark sea."
mem/0045/45/p47: Aine didn't answer my question, but continued speaking to me.
mem/0045/45/p48: "I'll teach you how to get back."
mem/0045/45/p50: "I'm not sure if the same method will work for you, but it's worth a try. I probably won't get another chance to say this, so listen carefully."
mem/0045/45/p51: After that, he taught me the only way to return home.
mem/0045/45/p53: "Just walk straight ahead. Don't rush. Don't get lost."
mem/0045/45/p54: Aine waved his hand small. This time, it felt like a real goodbye.
mem/0045/45/p55: "I'll go ahead, so let's meet again 'over there'."
mem/0045/45/p58: The white waves gently caressed only my standing feet.
mem/0045/45/p60: "Don't break your promise. I'm counting on you."
mem/0045/45/p61: After narrowing his indigo eyes and smiling, Aine's figure disappeared beyond the ripples.
mem/0045/45/p64: When I woke up next, I was standing before a vast blue sky and sea.
mem/0045/45/p65: I know. This is the world where I once was.
mem/0045/45/p66: A slightly peculiar scent of the sea, mixed with the grassy aroma drifting from the coast and the sweet fragrance of white-blooming flowers, tells me so.
mem/0045/45/p67: I hum the song from back then. I kept singing it, over and over again.
mem/0045/45/p68: I never thought that being able to sing would bring such joy.
mem/0045/45/p70: I heard her voice right after that.
mem/0045/45/p71: When I turned around, she was there. My beloved. I had wanted to see her for so, so long.
mem/0045/45/p73: She kicked up sand as she ran toward me.
mem/0045/45/p74: I opened my arms and tightly embraced her as she leaped into them.
mem/0046/46/p0: "I won't move from here until Takeru-san understands."
mem/0046/46/p1: What is this guy...? She's like a weed, yet she won't let go.
mem/0046/46/p2: Even when I treated her coldly, she didn't care at all.
mem/0046/46/p3: She charged straight at me without hesitation, even though I'm a god who should be avoiding her.
mem/0046/46/p5: I watched her and noticed her clenched fist was trembling.
mem/0046/46/p6: Is she angry because I paid for her bento, or is she afraid of me?
mem/0046/46/p7: Then why does she still keep talking to me?
mem/0046/46/p8: Is she only doing it because she has to for graduation?
mem/0046/46/p10: If I look into her eyes, I can tell. Those aren't the eyes of someone being forced. I feel a firm resolve that she is doing this because she wants to.
mem/0046/46/p12: Why do you bother with me? You should just give up.
mem/0046/46/p13: There's no way I'm playing 'friends' with you now. I don't want that kind of thing.
mem/0046/46/p15: I never told her to prepare a bento for me. It was just unnecessary meddling.
mem/0046/46/p16: Watching her gather up the dropped food makes my heart race.
mem/0046/46/p18: I feel bad for ruining the food.
mem/0046/46/p19: But I can't stop worrying about how sad she looked.
mem/0046/46/p20: Did you really want me to eat it that much?
mem/0046/46/p21: She said the bento should be Japanese-style, tailored to my tastes.
mem/0046/46/p22: It must have been the result of her carefully considering her options at the school store.

mem/0050/50/p19: I wanted to find its missing half, but I didn't even know if it was still on this vast beach.

mem/0050/50/p22: Where they were born, how they grew, and why they ended up here.

mem/0050/50/p24: My own worries suddenly felt so insignificant.
mem/0050/50/p25: "Watching you guys makes me forget about my boring problems."
mem/0050/50/p26: I started talking to the shells, and even I felt a bit crazy, so I let out a wry smile.

mem/0058/58/p32: "Well... that's true. So, what about Laevateinn?"

mem/0058/58/p37: When I reached for my bass, he smirked slightly.
mem/0058/58/p39: "Hey... are you trying to pick a fight?"

"First of all, Camus lies too much, making it hard to filter reliable information." "If I say I don't get it, what about the occasional drop in temperature observed around here?"

mem/0058/58/p61: I didn't want to believe he was shady... but...

mem/0059/59/p0: The world is filled with light.

mem/0059/59/p18: I managed to get him to memorize simple greetings and pass him off as a taciturn human, but I had to use magic to change his hair and skin color.
mem/0059/59/p19: Camu had no respect for the Muses; in fact, he was the kind of person who openly spoke ill of both Agna and the Muses and music itself. Casting a spell on him was, in Japanese terms, 'not a one-way street.'
mem/0059/59/p20: "...Even remembering it now makes me break into a cold sweat."
