mem/0059/59/p22: It seems some of the rebels were very familiar with Camu, and our plan was almost exposed.
mem/0059/59/p23: Even when I testified that Camu was in Japan during the coup under the name of Agna's prince,
mem/0059/59/p24: there were troubling complications where the other side had prepared further 'evidence.'
mem/0059/59/p25: Without the help of Mr. Da Ruma and the others, Camu wouldn't have been able to get close to the Queen.
mem/0059/59/p26: But all of that has been resolved.
mem/0059/59/p27: I heard that the marriage between me and the Queen was canceled, and the rebels were told that Camu was captured.
mem/0059/59/p28: My uncle and cousins will likely remain quiet for some time.
mem/0059/59/p29: As long as justice exists in this world, evil has never prospered!
mem/0059/59/p30: I believe that Silk Palace and our nation will maintain a proper distance in our future exchanges.
mem/0059/59/p31: I also heard that the Queen has given up on the vessel idea. Although the methods differ, exchanging with another nation that uses magic is not a bad thing for Agna.
mem/0059/59/p32: I nodded deeply and continued reading the letter.
mem/0059/59/p33: "I am sorry that I was in such a hurry and could not properly express my gratitude."
mem/0059/59/p35: Who could have imagined Camu would write words like these?
mem/0059/59/p36: "Therefore, I wish to express my gratitude once more. Would you be so kind as to suggest a convenient date and time?"
mem/0059/59/p37: A date and time convenient for me!!
mem/0059/59/p38: I stopped in my tracks and gazed at the letter with deep emotion.
mem/0059/59/p39: Camu apologizing and thanking me...! Who would have thought?
mem/0059/59/p40: "Ah, Muse, such things are indeed possible."
mem/0059/59/p41: Looking up at the sky, I voiced my gratitude.
mem/0059/59/p43: How wonderful. Gratitude to the heavens. Gratitude to the earth. Let us offer thanks to the rustling wind, the drifting clouds, and all things in this world.
mem/0059/59/p44: In the fading light of the setting sun, the entire world seems to sparkle.
mem/0059/59/p45: I had always thought of Camu as a tyrant, but that is no longer the case.
mem/0059/59/p46: Camu has become a good person! How amazing!
mem/0059/59/p47: The trees in the forest seemed to sway their branches and sing a song of joy. I headed toward Camu's house, moving lightly as if dancing.
mem/0059/59/p48: "{NAME}... You are truly a wonderful person."

mem/0059/59/p52: I want her to be happier than anyone else.

mem/0059/59/p55: If she is with the one she truly loves, she will surely be happy.

mem/0059/59/p78: "I take back my previous words! Do you know a phrase that fits this situation perfectly? 'Corroded resolve cannot be hammered back into shape.'"
mem/0059/59/p79: I made a declaration, Camu shouted, {NAME} trembled, and the dog barked.

mem/0060/60/p2: After thinking that, I was surprised by myself. Me, feeling chilly?

mem/0060/60/p178: Even when I glared at him, he simply tilted his head innocently.
mem/0060/60/p179: I turned my back to ignore him, only to meet {NAME}'s anxious eyes.
mem/0060/60/p182: The dog kept pulling the blanket harder. As I looked on in confusion, {NAME} smiled.
mem/0060/60/p183: "I'm not going anywhere. You'll stay with me forever, right, Senpai? Please, play with me, Christzard."
mem/0060/60/p185: Since he had called me by name, I couldn't very well refuse.
mem/0060/60/p187: I smiled wryly and nodded, and {NAME} beamed with joy.
mem/0060/60/p188: "Good. After you play with Alexander, please have a meal with me, Christzard."
mem/0060/60/p189: "Hmm. The timing seems right. That should be fine."
mem/0060/60/p190: "Yes. I've heard the food here is delicious, so I'm looking forward to it."
mem/0060/60/p191: "What? Didn't you stay here the other day?"
mem/0060/60/p192: "It's just that... I was so anxious back then... I couldn't even tell what the food tasted like."
mem/0060/60/p193: I see... Given the circumstances at the time, I suppose that's understandable.
mem/0060/60/p194: "And also... may I ask one more thing? I'd like to take a walk around the inn and go into the hot spring one more time. ...Christzard."
mem/0060/60/p196: I realized my gaze toward her had softened.
mem/0060/60/p197: It wasn't just for today; we would be together from now on. I could grant as many small wishes as she wanted. I could make them come true.
mem/0060/60/p198: "But, that makes four wishes. You may seem humble, but you're quite the demanding master."
mem/0060/60/p199: "N-no, that's not what I meant at all... If you dislike it, it's completely fine..."
mem/0060/60/p200: "Stop getting flustered over every little thing. If you're going to command me, have some dignity."
mem/0060/60/p201: When I smiled, she got flustered all over again.
mem/0060/60/p202: Watching us like that, the dog finally lost its patience and barked 'woof'.
mem/0060/60/p203: "Alright, alright. Alexander, I'll play with you. But first, bring me my clothes."
mem/0060/60/p205: As I watched Alexander run off in high spirits, {NAME} and I exchanged a glance.
mem/0060/60/p208: "Good morning. I hadn't had the chance to greet you yet today."
mem/0060/60/p209: Watching my lover bow politely, I smiled once more.
mem/0061/61/p0: Balder-san started talking about Japanese food as if he couldn't hold it back.
mem/0061/61/p1: It seems he really loves Japan; his face was full of life.
mem/0061/61/p2: It appears he learned about Japan after coming to the Garden.
mem/0061/61/p3: "There are Japanese gods here too, and more importantly, I heard you're from Japan, so I thought I'd look into it."
mem/0061/61/p4: I was very happy to realize that I was included in his motives.
mem/0061/61/p5: "Then it was very interesting. Japanese culture is full of things I didn't know, so it's fascinating."
mem/0061/61/p7: "Hmm, if we're talking about today's menu, it would be seaweed."
mem/0061/61/p8: He skillfully picked it up with his chopsticks. Had he practiced and learned how to use them?
mem/0061/61/p9: "They say seaweed comes from algae. I was surprised when I first learned that!"
mem/0061/61/p10: True, I didn't know what it was made of as a child and just ate it. I remember being surprised, just like Mr. Balder, when my mother explained it to me.
mem/0061/61/p11: "Also, mackerel is a fish whose freshness deteriorates very quickly. There's even a phrase, 'mackerel rotting alive,' to describe it. It seems their internal organs contain digestive enzymes that break down the flesh rapidly."
mem/0061/61/p13: Even for a common fish, surprising facts keep coming out.
mem/0061/61/p14: Is it just that I lack knowledge, or is Mr. Balder just diligent in his studies...?
mem/0061/61/p15: While I was thinking that, the conversation continued.
mem/0061/61/p16: "Because of how quickly it spoils, it's said that the phrase 'to read mackerel' was born. There are various theories about this, though."
mem/0061/61/p17: "So the 'mackerel' in that phrase referred to the fish."
mem/0061/61/p18: I'm amazed that he knows more about Japanese culture than I do.
mem/0061/61/p19: "When buying mackerel, he was probably panicking because it spoiled so easily. He rushed to count them, and the number he announced didn't match the actual count, which is how the phrase came to be."
mem/0061/61/p20: He carefully explains the etymology and meaning.
mem/0061/61/p21: Our conversation was so engaging that I hadn't moved my chopsticks at all.
mem/0061/61/p22: "Mr. Balder, if you don't start eating soon, you'll be late for class."
mem/0061/61/p23: "Right, right. Speaking of eating, didn't you say 'itadakimasu'? Do you know that phrase has two meanings?"
mem/0061/61/p24: He's completely ignoring what I'm saying...
mem/0061/61/p25: After that, he continued to talk endlessly about Japanese culture.
mem/0061/61/p26: I kept nodding along, eating my meal, and urging him to eat as well.
mem/0062/62/p1: It's the phrase Balder always mutters before meals.
mem/0062/62/p2: When I'm with him, hearing that phrase is my cue that it's time to eat.
mem/0062/62/p3: It's like a kind of alarm.
mem/0062/62/p4: "Hey, Thor, what kind of meat are you in the mood for?"
mem/0062/62/p8: I think there are plenty of options, but I'll leave it at that rather than pressing too hard.
mem/0062/62/p9: There's no need to rain on the parade of such an enthusiastic guy.
mem/0062/62/p10: "I think I'm in the mood for lamb! Fresh lamb is nice, but mutton has a deeper flavor too."
mem/0062/62/p12: I don't know much about it, but it's safer to just go along with the conversation.
mem/0062/62/p13: Probably, even if I said something, it wouldn't get through to him.
mem/0062/62/p14: That's how focused Balder gets on meat when he's talking about it.
mem/0062/62/p15: "The tenderness of meat never gets old, no matter how many times you taste it. And the juicy meat juices! The high-quality fat melts away, making the texture even smoother. It's almost ecstatic... Ah, it's irresistible! The steak I had the other day..."
mem/0062/62/p16: Just listening to Balder talk makes me feel a bit nauseous.
mem/0062/62/p17: I'll order something other than meat.
mem/0062/62/p18: "Loki, let's go to the cafeteria together!"
mem/0062/62/p19: "I had some snacks earlier, so~ I might not need dinner~*"
mem/0062/62/p20: Loki, who was making prank tools at his desk, waved at us to go ahead.
mem/0062/62/p21: "Hey, Loki! You have to eat a balanced diet."
mem/0062/62/p22: Balder saying that has zero persuasiveness.
mem/0062/62/p24: Loki flailed his legs like a child, trying to resist.
mem/0062/62/p25: I've gotten used to this scenery.
mem/0062/62/p26: "You have to eat your meat properly if you want to grow up!"
mem/0062/62/p27: "It's fine~* Besides, if you only eat meat, you'll get fat, won't you?"
mem/0062/62/p28: "Loki... would it be okay to take that as an insult to meat?"
mem/0062/62/p29: Balder's eyes flashed sharply. His face was smiling, but his eyes were deadly serious.
mem/0062/62/p31: Seizing the moment, Loki provoked him. Balder, taking it seriously, stood silent and frozen.
mem/0062/62/p33: "Don't stop me, Thor... Even Loki, I won't forgive you."
mem/0062/62/p34: Balder smiled and slowly snapped his fingers.
mem/0062/62/p35: "Oh? I don't mind serious Balder either~*"
mem/0062/62/p36: Loki, not to be outdone, rattled the prank tools hidden in his clothes.
mem/0062/62/p38: I shouted as loudly as I could.
mem/0062/62/p41: At this point, my preferences come second.
mem/0062/62/p45: "Yeah! Meat~ Meat~ Meat~ What's the meat today~~"
mem/0062/62/p46: Balder cheerfully opens the room's door while singing.
mem/0062/62/p47: And so, peace returned once more.
mem/0062/62/p48: As a price, I ended up eating a huge amount of meatballs while listening to Balder talk about meat.
mem/0063/63/t: In the World of Norse Myth
mem/0063/63/p0: The three of us often played together. No matter what we did, we were always together.
mem/0063/63/p1: It had somehow become the norm for the three of us to stay together since childhood.
mem/0063/63/p2: In the world of Norse mythology, it snowed a lot, and that day was incredibly cold.
mem/0063/63/p5: "It can't be helped, Thor. Loki is the god of fire, after all. He's weak against the cold."
mem/0063/63/p7: A world stretching out in pure white.
mem/0063/63/p8: We'd pile up Yggdrasil's leaves on a hill to make sleds and slide down, or use the snow as a canvas to draw giant pictures...
mem/0063/63/p9: It was all just trivial play, but with these three, we could enjoy anything.
mem/0063/63/p10: Only those with close companions can understand this joy. There was a profound emotion that couldn't be put into words.
mem/0063/63/p12: "Maybe the canvas was too big after all?"
mem/0063/63/p14: We finished painting a picture so large you couldn't see the whole thing without flying, and then we sat down on the snowfield.
mem/0063/63/p16: I looked in the direction Baldur was pointing, and there, light layered upon light, wove a beautiful gradient.
mem/0063/63/p17: A fantasy-like scene, breathtaking in its beauty, spread out before us.
mem/0063/63/p19: Thor murmured it softly, and we stared, forgetting all words.
mem/0063/63/p20: Fine particles of light rippled like they were fluttering in the wind.
mem/0063/63/p21: "Did you know? There's a superstition that anyone who sees the Aurora together will stay together for life."
mem/0063/63/p23: "Really!? Does that mean we'll be together forever?"
mem/0063/63/p25: Thor seemed a bit shy, but he didn't seem to dislike it.
mem/0063/63/p26: "Then let's come see it a lot!~ Maybe it'll be even more effective that way."
mem/0063/63/p27: "Yeah. But I don't need the effect to work."
mem/0063/63/p28: "Why? Wouldn't it be better to receive the benefits?"
mem/0063/63/p29: I felt a slight sting, as if Baldur were denying our bond.
mem/0063/63/p30: "Because even without the Aurora's effect, we'll always be best friends."
mem/0063/63/p31: With that, Baldur smiled, looking just like the God of Light himself.
mem/0063/63/p32: "Good grief... That's why I can't beat Baldur. Natural airheads are scary, scary*"
mem/0063/63/p33: I teased him with exaggerated flair, patting his head lightly.
mem/0063/63/p34: "Huh? Was I making a weird face?"
mem/0063/63/p36: We laughed over trivial things, repeating such exchanges endlessly.
mem/0063/63/p37: Yes, we were always happy when the three of us were together.
mem/0063/63/p38: Just like back then, and just like in the future...
mem/0064/64/p0: Outside, students were busy preparing for what they called the cultural festival.
mem/0064/64/p1: "It's too noisy. I can't stand it."
mem/0064/64/p2: I couldn't even enjoy reading a book in peace in the library, and on top of that, Zeus had summoned me...
mem/0064/64/p4: I opened the door to the principal's office.
mem/0064/64/p5: He went out of his way to call me here, so I could easily guess it would be some sort of trouble, but I had no right to refuse.
mem/0064/64/p6: "Ah, you've arrived. Thoth, you too will be running a stall at the cultural festival."
mem/0064/64/p7: I heard Zeus enjoys festivals by nature, but I didn't expect it to go this far.
mem/0064/64/p9: There was no need to ask for the reason.
mem/0064/64/p10: I knew I was just going to hear some ridiculous speech about setting an example as an instructor.
mem/0064/64/p11: "Don't make such a gloomy face. It's not all bad. Currency will be issued at the cultural festival, allowing you to get whatever you desire."
mem/0064/64/p12: "Desire? How silly. I have no particular wants."
mem/0064/64/p13: "My information says the gods of Japanese mythology are serving a delicious soup called 'Zenzai' made with beans. It seems to be a miracle food that relieves physical fatigue with its perfect sweetness."
mem/0064/64/p15: I don't dislike the sweetness of good beans, that's true.
mem/0064/64/p16: "I hear they're even sweeter than corn."
mem/0064/64/p17: "...If I join in, I'll monopolize the currency and halt circulation. Is that really okay?"
mem/0064/64/p18: "Ah, of course. Teaching the students about the harshness of the world is also quite an interesting endeavor."
mem/0064/64/p19: He flashes a wicked grin. Honestly, I can never understand what this man is thinking. Does he truly wish for the students' growth, or is he just doing it for his own amusement?
mem/0064/64/p20: "Then, considering we have the principal's permission, let's get started with preparations."
mem/0064/64/p21: I turn around and head back to the library.
mem/0064/64/p22: I hang a 'No Entry' sign on the library door and lock it.
mem/0064/64/p25: "I'll give you a special task. Make as many dolls as you can by the cultural festival. You decide on the design."
mem/0064/64/p27: Whether he misunderstands that he's being acknowledged or not, he happily obeys the order.
mem/0064/64/p28: "Good. Now I have the merchandise sorted. Next, I need to set a sales target. We'll need to adjust our sales strategy accordingly."
mem/0064/64/p29: I take out a piece of paper and set the circulation price for one bowl of Zenzai, then begin calculating the necessary amount so that everyone can enjoy it to their heart's content.
mem/0064/64/p30: A perfect plan is necessary to achieve the goal.
mem/0064/64/p31: Well... such a simple problem is child's play for me.
mem/0064/64/p32: And so, I made thorough preparations and headed toward the cultural festival.
mem/0065/65/p0: This afternoon, we had self-study because Thoth-sensei was absent.
mem/0065/65/p1: I wasn't given a specific reason, but I wonder if a teacher has something more important than class...
mem/0065/65/p2: Apollon-san and Hades-san are reading their books seriously.
mem/0065/65/p3: Dionysus-san is napping with a book resting on his face.
mem/0065/65/p4: Takeru-san is asking Tsukito-san a question, and Tsukito-san is answering him politely.
mem/0065/65/p7: Loki-san had already plopped down next to Balder-san and spread out his notebook.
mem/0065/65/p9: Balder-san gave his permission a moment later.
mem/0065/65/p10: "Actually, I've got something really great, but Balder, wanna try it?"
mem/0065/65/p11: With that, he pulled a pencil from his pocket. It was just an ordinary red pencil.
mem/0065/65/p12: "It feels so good to write with, and it's like the words just flow out like magic*"
mem/0065/65/p13: "Oh, really? I didn't know a pencil could make such a difference. I'd love to try it."
mem/0065/65/p14: Balder took it smoothly and curiously examined the pencil from various angles-up, down, left, and right.
mem/0065/65/p15: Watching from the side, Loki grinned mischievously.
mem/0065/65/p16: That was the look he wore whenever he was plotting something nasty.
mem/0065/65/p18: Thor-san seemed about to say something, but Loki quickly shut him up.
mem/0065/65/p19: Perhaps he had a bad feeling about it too.
mem/0065/65/p20: But it looked like nothing more than a regular pencil. It would be rude to doubt it...
mem/0065/65/p22: "Are you that curious? Then Loki can use it. I have my own pencil anyway."
mem/0065/65/p23: "No, no~! I want Balder to use the pencil too*"
mem/0065/65/p24: As I said that, I tried to hand the pencil back to Loki, but he gently pushed it back.
mem/0065/65/p25: "Is that so? Then I suppose I'll give it a try."
mem/0065/65/p26: The moment Balder gripped the pencil and placed the lead tip on the paper...
mem/0065/65/p28: The pencil started moving at an incredible speed. It was writing something automatically, but the characters were so nonsensical that I couldn't read them.
mem/0065/65/p29: But the real problem was that Balder-san's arm was being whipped around by the pencil.
mem/0065/65/p30: "Loki, this... is coming out of my... hands... Whoa!"
mem/0065/65/p31: "That's right, I even added a lock function*"
mem/0065/65/p33: The pencil was no longer confined to the notebook; it was starting to spill over onto the desk.
mem/0065/65/p34: Balder-san's hands moved wildly left and right, and his body swayed as if being pulled along.
mem/0065/65/p35: "Once it starts writing, it won't stop until the pencil is satisfied. I don't know how to stop it either."
mem/0065/65/p36: "Ugh, I feel like my eyes... are spinning."
mem/0065/65/p39: Apollon-san came over upon hearing the commotion, but at the sound of his approach, the pencil seemed startled and jumped violently.
mem/0065/65/p42: Two screams echoed throughout the classroom.
mem/0065/65/p43: Balder-san and Apollon-san, pulled up by the pencil, collided and both collapsed to the floor.
mem/0065/65/p45: I rushed over to them, and the pencil rolled back and forth at my feet.
mem/0065/65/p47: The pencil's rampage seemed to have stopped, but Apollon-san, who had been crushed beneath Balder-san, was still dizzy from the impact.
mem/0065/65/p48: "As expected, Balder is immortal~ But his lock function is still too weak, so I need to beef it up more*"
mem/0065/65/p51: When he tried to warn him, he spun around and hurried out of the classroom.
mem/0065/65/p52: "Oh, Loki... he's so dedicated to his research. I just hope he doesn't push himself too hard and ruin his health."
mem/0065/65/p53: "Balder-san, that's not the place you should be worrying about!"
mem/0065/65/p54: "Hehehe, but I'm glad you're worried about me. If that's the case, maybe I can stand a few more pranks."
mem/0065/65/p55: "That's not the spot! This isn't funny."
mem/0065/65/p57: Watching Balder-san smile at that, I was dumbfounded.
mem/0065/65/p58: But since Balder-san looked so happy, maybe that's just how it is.
mem/0065/65/p59: With things like this, our class is lively every day.
mem/0066/66/p0: When Odin, Balder's father, told me the truth, I couldn't believe my ears.
mem/0066/66/p1: Balder is the Destroyer God, destined to lead the world to ruin.
mem/0066/66/p3: He told us this out of a father's desire to let Balder live as a normal god for as long as possible.
mem/0066/66/p4: "Hey, can you believe it? Balder, who wouldn't even kill a bug, as the Destroyer God?"
mem/0066/66/p6: But I know it's not a lie. Odin wouldn't joke about something like that.
mem/0066/66/p7: Loki seems to understand that too.
mem/0066/66/p10: He's the God of Light, kind to everyone and loved by all. If he knew he'd bring the world to ruin, he'd feel a heavy sense of responsibility.
mem/0066/66/p11: "If Balder asks, we'll just tell him it's an 'incurable disease.' That's probably better for him."
mem/0066/66/p13: "Sometimes you have to lie! I'd rather protect Balder than hurt him."
mem/0066/66/p14: According to Odin, Balder's body is gradually being consumed by his immense power as the Destroyer God, until he's eventually dominated by it.
mem/0066/66/p15: He said his health could deteriorate significantly during this process.
mem/0066/66/p16: If we call it a 'disease,' Balder would probably accept it.
mem/0066/66/p17: Lately, he's looked unwell sometimes. It might be the effect of his power.
mem/0066/66/p19: "I'll stay by Balder's side until the very end."
mem/0066/66/p20: "...Even with the power to destroy the world?"
mem/0066/66/p21: Loki knows how dangerous this is, but his resolve is unshakable.
mem/0066/66/p22: "That's none of your business, Genius Loki! Besides, even if it's dangerous, we're best friends, right?"
mem/0066/66/p23: Loki puffed out his chest as if to say, "Who else but me should be by your side?"
mem/0066/66/p24: "...I see. Then I'll watch over both of you."
mem/0066/66/p25: "What do you mean 'both of you'? Just Balder is fine, isn't it?"
mem/0066/66/p26: "...Loki, you're reckless. That's why I'll watch over you too."
mem/0066/66/p27: Both of them are important friends to me.
mem/0066/66/p28: "That's so Thor-chan. Then we're always together, no matter what!"
mem/0066/66/p30: I vowed in my heart that I wouldn't let either of them be sad.
mem/0067/67/p0: I still remember well the time I first met her.
mem/0067/67/p1: At first, I thought she was just like everyone else.
mem/0067/67/p3: She helped me when I was being pushed around by the students at the academy.
mem/0067/67/p4: That was the first time I realized my ability to attract people didn't work on her.
mem/0067/67/p5: It had never happened before, so I was honestly surprised and it took a little time for me to believe it.
mem/0067/67/p6: She saw me not as the "God of Light," but as Balder, myself.
mem/0067/67/p7: Humans, animals, and even gods seek the light. The reason they are drawn to me is because, unconsciously, they are seeking its benefits.
mem/0067/67/p8: I didn't dislike being liked, but I felt a sense of loneliness knowing it wasn't due to my own charm.
mem/0067/67/p9: Loki and Thor, who had known me for a long time, understood me, but even my parents lost their composure when it came to me.
mem/0067/67/p10: In my love for her, I even borrowed the gods' powers to make myself immortal. It was hard to tell whether that was parental affection or the power of ability.
mem/0067/67/p11: Everyone reacts to me with nothing but goodwill.
mem/0067/67/p12: So I always keep a smile on my face, trying to respond in kind.
mem/0067/67/p13: Before I knew it, whether I was truly happy or not no longer mattered.
mem/0067/67/p14: Then she appeared before me, who had come to accept that as the norm.
mem/0067/67/p16: When I heard that, she looked at me with a very strange expression... no, I might even say a suspicious one.
mem/0067/67/p17: "Nothing much... you say? Oh, I'm not injured or anything."
mem/0067/67/p18: Do you know how surprised and overjoyed I was when I heard those words?
mem/0067/67/p19: I even felt that meeting her here was destiny.
mem/0067/67/p20: After that, as I spent time with her, those feelings turned into certainty.
mem/0067/67/p21: She looks at me for who I am and offers advice because she cares about me.
mem/0067/67/p22: There is no thought of seeking anything in return.
mem/0067/67/p23: I found that equal relationship so comfortable that I became more and more captivated.
mem/0067/67/p24: She is the special person who found me and gave me warm happiness.
mem/0068/68/p0: Every time I eat with Balder-san, I can't help but worry about his unbalanced diet.
mem/0068/68/p1: I decided I would make him eat his vegetables properly today...
mem/0068/68/p2: With that resolve, I piled dishes containing vegetables onto my plate from whatever was available in the cafeteria.
mem/0068/68/p3: "You're eating quite a lot today. A sign of good health."
mem/0068/68/p4: He peeks at my plate and smiles happily.
mem/0068/68/p5: He doesn't seem to realize that I'm trying to feed him all of this.
mem/0068/68/p6: Since he hates vegetables so much, I have to be extremely careful not to let him notice.
mem/0068/68/p7: "Eating with Balder-san makes everything taste so much better..."
mem/0068/68/p8: "Really? That makes me happy. Then let's eat quickly before the meat gets cold. Here we go~"
mem/0068/68/p9: He clasps his hands politely and immediately takes a bite of the meat.
mem/0068/68/p10: "Mmm~! Delicious~! The meat is perfect today too."
mem/0068/68/p11: With a meltingly sweet smile, he continues to eat the meat one bite after another.
mem/0068/68/p13: I place a stuffed pepper on the edge of his plate.
mem/0068/68/p14: My plan is to gradually get him used to it by starting with dishes that have less vegetables.
mem/0068/68/p15: "Wow, thank you. Then I won't hold back."
mem/0068/68/p16: I'm happy with his unexpectedly positive reaction... but...
mem/0068/68/p17: "Balder-san! Please don't separate the vegetables and the meat!"
mem/0068/68/p18: Skillfully, he scoops up only the meat part and swallows it in one bite.
mem/0068/68/p19: "Huh? Isn't this wrapped around the meat to keep it from burning? It's like a skin, so you don't have to eat it."
mem/0068/68/p20: There's no way that's true. How does he even interpret it that way?
mem/0068/68/p21: However, his words were so forceful that I found myself giving in without thinking.
mem/0068/68/p22: "Mr. Meat, Mr. Meat! Come into my mouth."
mem/0068/68/p23: Humming to himself, he reaches for the next meat dish with his chopsticks.
mem/0068/68/p24: If I don't do something, things will just go on as usual. I steeled my resolve and brought it up.
mem/0068/68/p25: "Balder-san, I have a favor to ask."
mem/0068/68/p26: "What's wrong? You haven't been eating much since earlier."
mem/0068/68/p27: "I really want you to eat your vegetables! I'm worried about your health."
mem/0068/68/p28: It's best to be straightforward in situations like this.
mem/0068/68/p29: "Vegetables... Even if you ask me, it might be a bit difficult..."
mem/0068/68/p31: Even though he's a god, he's in a human body right now. A diet this one-sided could be bad for his health.
mem/0068/68/p32: "You look so serious. ...Are you really that worried about me?"
mem/0068/68/p34: "Then... if you fed me, I might be able to do it."
mem/0068/68/p36: He made such a bold proposal as if it were nothing.
mem/0068/68/p37: "Is it too hard? I don't think I could handle that bitterness on my own."
mem/0068/68/p38: Normally, Balder wouldn't even suggest eating on his own, so for him to say this was a significant step forward.
mem/0068/68/p40: When it comes to his health, my embarrassment doesn't matter. I have to show him my seriousness!
mem/0068/68/p41: I pick up a stuffed pepper with my chopsticks and bring it toward his mouth, but my hand starts to tremble as it gets closer.

mem/0072/72/p1: My conflict began the moment I learned that Balder was the god of destruction who would lead the world to ruin.
mem/0072/72/p2: I decided to kill Balder with my own hands, with these very hands.
mem/0072/72/p3: I wonder when I started thinking that way. I think it was a time so long ago that it makes my head spin.
mem/0072/72/p4: Even when Balder was smiling, I never knew when he might show signs of distress.
mem/0072/72/p5: Every time his health faltered, I worried, and I was constantly tormented by these thoughts.
mem/0072/72/p6: Could I really bring myself to kill him?
mem/0072/72/p7: Was my desire to kill him meant to save Balder, or to protect many others from sacrifice?
mem/0072/72/p8: No matter how much I thought about it, I couldn't make up my mind.
mem/0072/72/p9: Countless sleepless nights, days spent tormented by nightmares.
mem/0072/72/p10: Then, at one point, words spoken by Balder troubled me even more.
mem/0072/72/p11: "I am content as long as everyone is happy. Seeing someone suffer is more painful to me than any pain I endure myself."

mem/0072/72/p13: It felt like I was being forced to choose the option of "killing," which was unbearable to accept.
mem/0072/72/p14: Yet, before I knew it, I had arrived at the conclusion that I would release Balder from his cruel fate with my own hands.
mem/0072/72/p15: Because I believed that was the greatest happiness for Balder.
mem/0072/72/p16: Even after coming to the academy, I felt that moment drawing near and prepared everything to perfection.
mem/0072/72/p17: And so, to ensure Balder could enjoy his time as much as possible, we created many memories together.
mem/0072/72/p18: We lived our days at the academy with care, so that there would be no regrets.
mem/0072/72/p19: But when that moment finally arrived, my hands trembled, and my entire body rejected the act of killing.
mem/0072/72/p20: Balder is someone precious to me.
mem/0072/72/p21: I would do it even if it meant making the world my enemy or sacrificing everything.
mem/0072/72/p22: I heard the sound of the blade slipping from my hand.
mem/0072/72/p23: It was the sound of the beginning of the world's destruction...

mem/0076/76/p27: "What is this! This is awesome! So cool!"

mem/0076/76/p30: "That was invented by humans, you know? Have you changed your mind about us?"

mem/0076/76/p34: With his hands, even a hand warmer could become a tool for mischief...

mem/0076/76/p43: Shrieks of surprise rose up everywhere.

mem/0077/77/p1: During lunch break, Loki, Balder, and I received bento boxes from Thor.
mem/0077/77/p3: It all started when I requested Thor's famous delicious bento a little while ago...
mem/0077/77/p6: The two of them were more excited than I was.
mem/0077/77/p8: "Thor-chin's cooking is amazing* Once you try it, you'll be hooked for sure~"
mem/0077/77/p9: "{NAME}-san. Come on, hurry up and open it."
mem/0077/77/p10: "...You're making a big deal out of nothing."
mem/0077/77/p11: Whether he was eager to eat or just wanted to show off, he was urging me on.
mem/0077/77/p13: He must have combined everyone's portions into one. I opened the lid of the large, three-tiered bento box.
mem/0077/77/p16: It was packed to the brim with delicious-looking traditional Japanese dishes.
mem/0077/77/p17: Fried chicken, rolled omelet, grilled salmon, nikujaga, spinach with sesame dressing, kinpira gobo...
mem/0077/77/p18: Neatly arranged rice balls lined the second tier.
mem/0077/77/p19: The bottom tier was filled with colorful fruits.
mem/0077/77/p20: It felt like a sports day or a picnic... My heart leaped at the sight of such a luxurious bento, usually only seen on special occasions.
mem/0077/77/p21: "They all look delicious! But it's all traditional Japanese food. That was a bit surprising."
mem/0077/77/p22: Since he's a god of Norse mythology, I had imagined a more Western-style menu, so I was quite taken aback.
mem/0077/77/p23: I can't really picture Thor-san neatly rolling an omelet.
mem/0077/77/p25: "No! Not at all. I like all of these foods, and I'm really happy."
mem/0077/77/p27: "Hehehe, Thor made this especially for you."
mem/0077/77/p28: "He thought that if I cooked food from where you're from, you'd feel nostalgic and be happy~"
mem/0077/77/p29: "...You don't need to say unnecessary things."
mem/0077/77/p30: The information brought by the two of them makes Thor-san look just a little embarrassed.
mem/0077/77/p31: "Thank you very much. I'm really happy."
mem/0077/77/p32: I think it's wonderful that he considers not just the presentation, but also the feelings of the person eating the food.
mem/0077/77/p33: "...I made a lot of these for the first time. ...I can't guarantee the taste."
mem/0077/77/p34: "Oh, come on~! Thor-chin can make anything perfectly~*"
mem/0077/77/p35: Loki-san pats Thor-san on the back repeatedly.
mem/0077/77/p36: "That's right, Thor. And if she likes it, it'll be an official seal of approval from a Japanese person, right?"
mem/0077/77/p37: It's heartwarming to see how much Thor-san is being doted on by the two of them.
mem/0077/77/p39: I take a bite of the golden-yellow rolled omelet, which has no browned spots at all.
mem/0077/77/p41: Because it's a simple cooking method, you can really tell his skill. From the carefully folded layers of egg, a rich, high-quality dashi flavor slowly overflows.
mem/0077/77/p42: This might be even more delicious than Mom's...
mem/0077/77/p45: "Alright, I can't hold back anymore! I'm going to eat the meat."
mem/0077/77/p46: Balder-san immediately picks up his chopsticks to grab some karaage.
mem/0077/77/p47: "Ah, that's cheating~~! I get the fruit*"
mem/0077/77/p48: "...There's no need to rush. There's plenty."
mem/0077/77/p49: And so, our fun lunch began.
mem/0077/77/p50: The bento was delicious, but I think eating it with this group made it taste even better.
mem/0077/77/p51: If the bento is this good, I'd want to eat it every day.
mem/0078/78/p0: Balder and I understand each other without needing words.
mem/0078/78/p1: I feel like we have that kind of relationship.
mem/0078/78/p2: Our personalities are completely different, but we complement each other's weaknesses, making us the perfect duo.

mem/0078/78/p5: Just by saying that, most of the students at the academy searched for it with intense determination.
mem/0078/78/p6: Thanks to that search, I found my lost item and was able to successfully prank Balder with it.
mem/0078/78/p7: If I had asked for help, no one would have bothered to assist me.
mem/0078/78/p8: I was a bit annoyed at Balder's popularity, but I didn't mind the envious looks my lackeys gave me.
mem/0078/78/p9: Balder is kind to everyone, but he rarely takes action specifically for anyone. Since he did it for me, jealousy was inevitable.
mem/0078/78/p10: It felt good to show those random upstarts that we're on a whole different level.
mem/0078/78/p11: Of course, Balder probably thinks he needs me too.

mem/0078/78/p13: The fact that he can wake up in the morning and come to school without forgetting anything is thanks to my inventions.
mem/0078/78/p14: There are plenty more examples, but I'll skip them since listing them all would never end.
mem/0078/78/p15: Even my pranks are designed to improve Balder's attention span.
mem/0078/78/p16: It also helps strengthen his resolve and improve his ability to handle crises.
mem/0078/78/p17: Well, it's also because I find it fun.
mem/0078/78/p18: If Balder truly disliked it, he'd get angry, but he's never scolded me for my pranks.
mem/0078/78/p19: Instead, he worries that I might get tired from being so absorbed in them.
mem/0078/78/p20: No one knows Balder better than I do, and he understands me.
mem/0078/78/p21: I find this relationship comforting, and I want to protect it no matter what.
mem/0078/78/p22: After all, Balder is my strongest and best partner.
mem/0078/78/p23: I can't imagine losing him, so I'd even bend fate itself for his sake.
mem/0079/79/p0: "Please, Your Highness, don't say that... I'll build a castle for you."
mem/0079/79/p1: Loki bowed respectfully, as if a servant were speaking to a princess.
mem/0079/79/p2: "If it's Loki-san, it looks like a real castle could be built."
mem/0079/79/p3: Those words seemed to ignite a fire in him. He grinned and pulled out a row of inventions from his clothes.
mem/0079/79/p4: It's truly a mystery where he keeps all those things inside his outfit.
mem/0079/79/p5: They were familiar tools needed to build a sandcastle, like shovels, trowels, and giant buckets, but they had a slightly different vibe.
mem/0079/79/p6: They seemed to have been modified, radiating a somewhat ominous aura.
mem/0079/79/p8: Seeing him roll up his sleeves made my heart skip a beat.
mem/0079/79/p9: Looking at his muscular arms, I realized that Loki, who looks slender and androgynous, is indeed a man.
mem/0079/79/p10: "You just cheer me on from there* That's enough for the princess's job!"
mem/0079/79/p11: Noticing my gaze, he spun around and flashed a wink.
mem/0079/79/p13: People say he has a devilish charm, but maybe that description fits Loki-san perfectly.
mem/0079/79/p14: He draws people in with his mood-swinging, captivating expressions, being gentle one moment and cold the next, with a perfect balance of pace.
mem/0079/79/p15: That contrast is probably what bewitches people.
mem/0079/79/p16: "Hey! Princess! You're slacking on your cheering duties~*"
mem/0079/79/p17: I was lost in thought, and before I knew it, the base of the castle was already finished.
mem/0079/79/p18: It looked tall enough that an adult would have to crouch to fit inside.
mem/0079/79/p19: ...In such a short time, and yet it was already done.
mem/0079/79/p21: "Well, when I get serious, stuff like this is a breeze~~"
mem/0079/79/p23: I threw out every cheering word I could think of at Loki-san.
mem/0079/79/p25: After that, Loki-san's magic shovel deftly opened the entrance, while the trowel automatically dug out the outer walls.
mem/0079/79/p26: Meanwhile, a small vehicle resembling a shovel truck dug a moat around the castle.
mem/0079/79/p27: Indeed, this was faster than building it all by myself.
mem/0079/79/p28: It was like watching a time-lapse, with a magnificent castle rising before my eyes.
mem/0079/79/p29: The craftsmanship was incredibly detailed and high-quality, far exceeding what one would expect from its speed.
mem/0079/79/p30: This was nothing like the sandcastles I used to build as a child.
mem/0079/79/p31: "Well then~! There you have it* Done!"
mem/0079/79/p32: "Amazing...! I might even say this is a work of art."
mem/0079/79/p33: Loki-san said he was making this for me, and I was so happy I felt like I'd received a huge present.
mem/0079/79/p35: He resumes his affected manner, bowing and fawning over me.
mem/0079/79/p36: "Oh yes, of course! From today on, this is my castle."
mem/0079/79/p37: I play along, acting the part of a princess.
mem/0079/79/p40: At his over-the-top behavior, we look at each other and laugh.
mem/0079/79/p41: After that, we went inside the castle and spent a while having fun.
mem/0080/80/p0: I like Loki when he's smiling.
mem/0080/80/p1: The way he acts, unbound by anyone, free and wild.
mem/0080/80/p2: If he's laughing, if he's happy, I don't mind being the target of his pranks.
mem/0080/80/p3: He and I are completely different kinds of people.
mem/0080/80/p4: In exchange for being loved unconditionally by others, I must respond to their affection.
mem/0080/80/p5: Even if it's just a gift, I can't neglect it.

mem/0080/80/p17: My body won't last much longer.

mem/0080/80/p20: Won't sudden loss drive him mad with grief?
mem/0080/80/p21: Because I know Loki's kindness, he will blame himself for not being able to save me.
mem/0080/80/p22: If my fate is to come to an end, I want him to be happy until the very last moment, and I want to watch him be so.
mem/0080/80/p23: It's okay if I'm not by his side.
mem/0080/80/p24: It might be selfish of me, but I chose to keep my distance from him.
mem/0080/80/p25: It is enough for just me to be bound by this wretched body.
mem/0080/80/p26: I want him to be happy for both of us. I want him to smile.

mem/0105/105/p203: "Seriously. How do you even make it take that shape..."
mem/0105/105/p204: "Hmm, I guess it's just by feel?"
mem/0105/105/p206: "It's amazing that you can make something so cute just by feel, Shinonome-san!"
mem/0105/105/p207: "Since I like cute things, I wanted to make it look cute and taste delicious. Oh, I'll give the bunny one to {NICK}-chan."
mem/0105/105/p208: Natsuki handed the cotton candy to {NAME}.
mem/0105/105/p210: "Ah, the bunny one is delicious too."
mem/0105/105/p211: "Having two is a bit much... You don't have to force yourself to eat them. If you can't finish them, I'll eat them for you."
mem/0105/105/p212: Sho. The confidence he had earlier is gone.
mem/0105/105/p213: He's probably feeling down because Natsuki was just so much better.
mem/0105/105/p214: "Thank you. Your cotton candy, Sho-kun, was also very delicious."
mem/0105/105/p215: "What should we do next? Shall we go to a haunted house or something?"
mem/0105/105/p217: "Eh. Ah... umm... It sounds fun, but the scary part is... I'm not very good with that kind of thing..."
mem/0105/105/p218: {NAME} lowered her head with an apologetic expression.
mem/0105/105/p220: "If you're scared, you can cling to me."
mem/0105/105/p222: "Hey, don't just push ahead with your own ideas!"
mem/0105/105/p223: "That's right. It's unfair that only Ren-kun and the others get to go."
mem/0105/105/p224: Natsuki, who is always smiling, pouted in an unusual display of annoyance.
mem/0105/105/p226: "There's no need to be nervous. I'm here with you. I won't let those monsters so much as touch a single finger on you."
mem/0105/105/p227: He took {NAME}'s hand and started walking, as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
mem/0105/105/p228: It was so natural that there was no room for me to interject.
mem/0105/105/p229: You have to go through the haunted house in pairs, so we had to wait a bit after the previous group went in.
mem/0105/105/p230: "Damn it. Is it still not our turn...?"
mem/0105/105/p231: "Sho. There's no point in rushing. Let's enjoy the haunted house together, the two of us."
mem/0105/105/p232: "Idiot. We can meet up inside if we hurry. ...It's a bit scary, but let's try to catch up to the first pair."
mem/0105/105/p233: "I see. Then, I'll do my best."
mem/0105/105/p234: We entered the haunted house with high spirits, but...
mem/0105/105/p237: The swarm of monsters attacking us one after another made our legs go weak.
mem/0105/105/p239: "Ah, well, of course... It is a haunted house, after all."
mem/0105/105/p240: We trembled and quaked, taking each step with trepidation.
mem/0105/105/p243: "It's fine. Kusanagi. Hold on tight to me."
mem/0105/105/p245: I could hear {NAME} and Masato's voices ahead of us.
mem/0105/105/p246: "Tch. That Seikawa guy. He's having all the fun by himself. I'll definitely catch up. Let's go, Cecil."
mem/0105/105/p249: The moment we started walking, someone grabbed my foot.
mem/0105/105/p252: I heard Tokiya and Ren's voices from right behind me.
mem/0105/105/p253: "If you're not going to move, please step aside. You're blocking the way behind me."
mem/0105/105/p254: "If you're scared, shall I hold your hand and lead you through?"
mem/0105/105/p256: "Don't mock me. I'm not scared at all."
mem/0105/105/p257: "Oh? Well then, do your best to catch up, you little ones."
mem/0105/105/p258: And so, Ren and Tokiya calmly walked along the haunted path.
mem/0105/105/p259: "Darn it. They're making fun of us."
mem/0105/105/p262: I turned around, and Otoya and Natsuki were standing right behind me.
mem/0105/105/p263: "Would you like to come with us? We won't be scared if we're all together."
mem/0105/105/p264: Natsuki offered me a gentle voice.
mem/0105/105/p267: "Cecil. Your knees are shaking. Come on, let's go together. Okay?"
mem/0105/105/p268: Otoya grabbed my clothes and marched forward.
mem/0105/105/p269: "If you rush so much, the ghosts will... Grrr!"
mem/0105/105/p270: I couldn't help but hide behind Otoya's back.
mem/0105/105/p271: "It is scary, but these are just dolls. They're not real, so it's fine."
mem/0105/105/p273: Sho said this while hiding behind Natsuki's back.
mem/0105/105/p274: In the end, the four of us left the haunted house without catching up to Masato or even Ren and the others.
mem/0105/105/p276: "Sho-kun, Cecil-san. Are you okay? You're pale as a sheet."
mem/0105/105/p277: As soon as we left the haunted house, {NAME} ran over, looking worried.
mem/0105/105/p279: "The haunted house was scarier than I expected."
mem/0105/105/p280: "Yes. It was very scary. Comfort me, {NAME}."
mem/0105/105/p285: After that, we wandered around the amusement park and had a wonderful time.
mem/0105/105/p286: "Ah, that was fun. I didn't know amusement parks could be this much fun."
mem/0105/105/p287: As we left the amusement park, {NAME} said happily.
mem/0105/105/p288: When {NAME} is happy, I am happy too.
mem/0105/105/p289: It seemed everyone felt the same way; they all agreed to hang out together again.
mem/0105/105/p290: I wasn't used to being alone with just one person, but I had a great time.
mem/0105/105/p291: So, let's all get along for a while.
mem/0105/105/p292: And let's make a good song together.
mem/0106/91/p0: Books are among the finest creations of humanity.
mem/0106/91/p2: And since many people can share that knowledge...
mem/0106/91/p3: The library is filled with books containing all that knowledge.
mem/0106/91/p4: There are countless volumes, but not so many that I can't read them.
mem/0106/91/p5: Since I have nothing else to do while at the academy, spending time reading isn't a bad idea.
mem/0106/91/p6: "The color of the flowers has faded, / In vain, while I gazed at my life, / Ono no Komachi."
mem/0106/91/p7: It's a very human kind of worry.
mem/0106/91/p8: "Even in the age of the gods, no one spoke of it, / Yet the Tatsuta River / Is dyed crimson by the evening glow. / Arai Narihira"
mem/0106/91/p9: "Chihayaburu" is a maegami for "Kami"... I see.
mem/0106/91/p10: I read them aloud one after another.
mem/0106/91/p11: That way, they're easier to commit to memory.
mem/0106/91/p13: As I turn the pages, I glance up and notice the airhead staring intently at me.
mem/0106/91/p15: Well, it's fine. She'll leave when she gets bored.
mem/0106/91/p16: I turn the pages one by one, reading out Japanese poems.
mem/0106/91/p17: Reading the explanations written beside them makes it quite interesting.
mem/0106/91/p18: "On this long, peaceful spring day, / Without a care in the world, / The flowers scatter. / Kiyohara no Tomonori"
mem/0106/91/p19: "Mr. Caduceus, you're so fast. Is that a Japanese poem? It looks like Japanese text."
mem/0106/91/p20: The airhead suddenly speaks to me in a leisurely tone.
mem/0106/91/p21: "So what? You've been staring at me this whole time. If you have something to ask, just say it."
mem/0106/91/p22: "No, I don't really have anything to ask. I just got captivated by how graceful your movements were."
mem/0106/91/p24: I was simply reading a book, but apparently, it touched the airhead's heartstrings.
mem/0106/91/p25: "I've been interested in Japanese culture lately."
mem/0106/91/p26: "I see. That's good. You're distracting me from my reading. Go away."
mem/0106/91/p27: I told her that, but I picked the wrong person to say it to.
mem/0106/91/p28: She smiles, seemingly pleased, standing in the same spot without moving a muscle.
mem/0106/91/p29: "I was just thinking how wonderful it is that you can read through books so quickly."
mem/0106/91/p31: "Caduceus-sensei, please make Baldr Fringhorn your disciple..."
mem/0106/91/p33: I didn't need to hear the rest. I gave an immediate answer and returned to focusing on my book.
mem/0106/91/p35: "I am serious, Caduceus-sensei. I want to learn so many more things, but I just don't have enough time. If I could read books any faster, I could gain more knowledge, right?"
mem/0106/91/p36: Ignoring me only made her keep talking, which finally got on my nerves.
mem/0106/91/p38: "What is it, Sensei? Are you going to make me your disciple?"
mem/0106/91/p39: "Reading isn't that simple. To read at my speed requires blood-pumping effort. Even for me, it took a hundred years to master."
mem/0106/91/p40: It was all nonsense. There's no way someone as brilliant as me would spend a hundred years on such a trivial matter.
mem/0106/91/p44: Had she realized I was lying?
mem/0106/91/p45: "I see. I'm sorry. I'll be fine reading at a normal speed."
mem/0106/91/p46: She bowed and thanked me, then disappeared toward the shelf holding books on Japanese culture.
mem/0106/91/p47: What was all that persistence for?
mem/0106/91/p48: "I cannot understand what the airhead is thinking."
mem/0106/91/p49: I feel exhausted. I think I'll take a rest.
mem/0106/91/p50: I let out a deep breath, closed the book, and stood up from my seat.
mem/0107/92/p0: I'm carrying corn to the library with Thoth.
mem/0107/92/p1: We can sometimes get it from the school store, but today I harvested corn planted in a secret spot known only to Anubis, so I'm having him help me carry it.
mem/0107/92/p2: It seems Thoth prefers the corn Anubis grew over the corn from the school store.
mem/0107/92/p3: "Indeed, the leaves covering the ears are vibrant and glossy. This looks delicious."
mem/0107/92/p4: Does he want to eat it right away? He's staring at the corn with eyes that seem to sparkle more than usual.
mem/0107/92/p5: "Thoth, you really like this, don't you?"
mem/0107/92/p6: "This is not it. It is maize. Well, corn is fine too. In English, it is called corn."
mem/0107/92/p7: Thoth glances at Anubis with a slight frown.
mem/0107/92/p9: Do I really need to use the proper name to avoid being rude?
mem/0107/92/p10: "Then let's go with corn. It sounds cuter."
mem/0107/92/p11: "Indeed. That is fine. This is a good opportunity. I shall teach you the wonders of maize."
mem/0107/92/p12: "Eh? I'm not really interested in Anubis."
mem/0107/92/p13: "We still have time before we reach the library. It is knowledge worth knowing."
mem/0107/92/p15: Thoth's intense presence is overwhelming, so Anubis decided to listen quietly.
mem/0107/92/p16: "Maize is a monocotyledonous plant in the grass family. It is used not only as food for humans and livestock but also as a raw material for oil and bioethanol."
mem/0107/92/p19: It's complicated and I don't quite get it, but Thoth seems so happy about it, so I guess it must be important.
mem/0107/92/p20: "Because of its delicious taste, various varieties have been developed. The kernels come in many colors; besides the yellow we usually eat, there are white, red, black, and even multi-colored ones. Some can even be eaten raw."
mem/0107/92/p22: Thoth is talking more than usual, so Anubis is happy.
mem/0107/92/p23: "It's delicious boiled, but eating it raw is quite novel. It must be very sweet. Usually, it tastes sweeter when heated."
mem/0107/92/p25: "However, the umami condensed in those tiny kernels is supreme. It's a flavor that makes even gods marvel. Not only is its sweetness elegant, but the perfect crunch is irresistible. That crisp, crunchy texture stimulates the appetite."
mem/0107/92/p26: "So sweet, so sweet! Anubis loves it the most!"
mem/0107/92/p29: "Let's hurry. This way is shorter... Follow me."
mem/0107/92/p30: With that, Thoth speeds up his walking pace.
mem/0107/92/p32: Anubis desperately chases after Thoth's back.
mem/0107/92/p33: But somehow, it feels like playing tag, and it's fun.
mem/0107/92/p34: I want to go home quickly and eat corn with Thoth!
mem/0108/93/p0: Today, I'm leaving the Kusanagi residence for a walk.
mem/0108/93/p1: Recently, Kusanagi seems to be interested in Thoth.
mem/0108/93/p2: Even after returning to my room, I only talk about him.
mem/0108/93/p3: I'll lend a hand for Kusanagi and look into Thoth for her.
mem/0108/93/p4: I sneak into the library quietly.
mem/0108/93/p7: Corn makes for great drinking snacks too. It's best when you chew each kernel slowly.
mem/0108/93/p8: Nothing out of the ordinary, so I leave the library.
mem/0108/93/p9: I pretend to nap among the books. The sunlight's a bit harsh, but it can't be helped.
mem/0108/93/p10: The lunch bell rings, and Thoth returns to the library once more.
mem/0108/93/p11: It seems he takes his breaks in the library.
mem/0108/93/p14: Did he manage to get a huge amount?
mem/0108/93/p15: After finishing his meal, he reads until time runs out.
mem/0108/93/p16: He's turning pages at an incredible speed. Is he even reading them?
mem/0108/93/p17: Still, he seems like a surprisingly serious god. Before I know it, class is about to start.
mem/0108/93/p19: I eat my snacks and take naps until after school.
mem/0108/93/p20: Students visit the campus after school, making it a bit lively, but it returns to silence when dismissal time comes.
mem/0108/93/p21: At dismissal time, Thoth returns to the library and immediately shoos away the students who are staying behind.
mem/0108/93/p23: "Hmm, I've acquired some fine corn. This looks delicious."
mem/0108/93/p25: I almost blurted that out, but I managed to hold it in. I was on a reconnaissance mission.
mem/0108/93/p28: "What are you sneaking around doing since morning? Are you mimicking a thief?"
mem/0108/93/p29: "I'm not a thief! I'm a detective!"
mem/0108/93/p30: I jumped in front of Thoth to protest. If I'm caught, I'll face it manfully and honorably!
mem/0108/93/p32: Ignoring me, Thoth seems intent on preparing dinner.
mem/0108/93/p33: "Whatever... but don't you eat too pickily? You've only had corn since morning. You should eat other nutrients too."
mem/0108/93/p34: Even for a god, a biased diet isn't good.
mem/0108/93/p35: "Shut up, mud. I don't want to be lectured by a failure."
mem/0108/93/p36: "W-what did you say?! I was trying to be helpful, and you call me a failure?!"
mem/0108/93/p38: "For a teacher, you should at least pay attention to nutritional balance."
mem/0108/93/p39: "I am perfectly healthy. Rather, I believe consuming things I dislike and feeling stressed is worse for my body. Well, I suppose a mud doll wouldn't understand."
mem/0108/93/p41: This is exactly what they mean by 'arguing over every little thing.'
mem/0108/93/p42: "It seems useless to say anything to you."
mem/0108/93/p43: "None of your business. Get out quickly."
mem/0108/93/p44: "I'll leave even if you don't ask me to."
mem/0108/93/p45: He jumped down from the shelf, stomped his feet loudly on purpose, and walked out.
mem/0108/93/p46: "That guy has a few screws loose."
mem/0108/93/p47: Getting involved with him leads to nothing good. He's truly a weirdo.
mem/0109/94/p1: Why does he keep visiting the library without getting bored? He doesn't give up even though I treat him so coldly.
mem/0109/94/p2: Is this another kind of training?
mem/0109/94/p3: He says he wants to learn about the gods, but I can't quite grasp his true intentions.
mem/0109/94/p4: Most humans... or even gods, for that matter, will stop approaching me easily after experiencing my handling of them just once.
mem/0109/94/p5: Normally, few people want to have unpleasant experiences.
mem/0109/94/p6: Even those overflowing with a spirit of self-sacrifice sometimes unconsciously seek some kind of return.
mem/0109/94/p7: I don't sense that from Kusanagi.
mem/0109/94/p8: So, I decided to try various experiments. Just to see what kind of reactions she would have.
mem/0109/94/p9: I tried my best to act in ways that would make me hated.
mem/0109/94/p10: That way, she wouldn't come near me anymore.
mem/0109/94/p11: It's a wonderful plan: studying human reactions while also getting rid of the trouble.
mem/0109/94/p12: ...No. It might be more accurate to say 'used to be'.
mem/0109/94/p13: No matter what I did to her, the light of hope never faded from her eyes.
mem/0109/94/p14: I wonder what she's hoping for in this state.
mem/0109/94/p15: Could it be that I'm suddenly being kind to her?
mem/0109/94/p16: Perhaps she believes in the gods in her own way.
mem/0109/94/p17: Or is it a sense of responsibility, since she said she was here to learn?
mem/0109/94/p18: In that sense, she's quite interesting. She's a type of human I've never met before.
mem/0109/94/p19: Well then, I'll grant her wish.
mem/0109/94/p21: When I called out to her, she turned around with an expression mixing surprise and anticipation.
mem/0109/94/p23: "I'm tired from reading after such a long time. Find me someone to distract me."
mem/0110/95/p1: For some reason, my nose is ticklish and my body feels warm.
mem/0110/95/p2: That's strange. It's snowing outside and it's so cold.
mem/0110/95/p4: "What is it, Thoth... Ah, Bless you!!"
mem/0110/95/p5: Oh my, the surroundings are starting to get wobbly and spinning.
mem/0110/95/p6: "Thoth~. Isn't my body spinning on its own?"
mem/0110/95/p8: Strange. Now my mouth is chattering.
mem/0110/95/p9: It was warm just a moment ago, but now it's suddenly cold.
mem/0110/95/p11: I try to speak properly, but my mouth won't move right.
mem/0110/95/p12: "Hey, stop flailing around. Just stay still for a bit."
mem/0110/95/p13: Thoth places his hand on Anubis's forehead.
mem/0110/95/p14: It's cool and feels nice. I wish he'd keep it there forever~.
mem/0110/95/p16: But then, he grabs my jaw and forces my mouth open.
mem/0110/95/p18: "Fever. Sneezing. Chills. Headache. Swollen throat. These are all clear symptoms of a cold."
mem/0110/95/p19: "A cold? The thing that goes 'whoosh whoosh'?"
mem/0110/95/p22: To Anubis, they sound the same.
mem/0110/95/p23: "Good grief... You're sick because you went out playing in thin clothes during this cold weather, you idiot."
mem/0110/95/p24: Thoth's face looks scarier than usual...
mem/0110/95/p26: It's the first time I've seen him look like this.
mem/0110/95/p27: What should I do? He's going to scold me. I need to apologize properly.
mem/0110/95/p32: Thoth carried me and laid me down on his bed.
mem/0110/95/p34: "It's special. Your bed is usually the floor or a sofa. Terrible places."
mem/0110/95/p35: I was tucked in with plenty of blankets that smelled like the sun on a soft, fluffy bed.
mem/0110/95/p36: "Thoth, you're a bit heavy... It's hard to breathe..."
mem/0110/95/p37: "Endure it. You're acting strange as usual."
mem/0110/95/p38: Then he placed a bag of cold water under my head. It felt cool, and the throbbing in my head eased slightly.
mem/0110/95/p39: "Next, I need to prepare a meal that's easy to digest and nutritious. Good grief, having such a troublesome idiot around just creates extra work. It's a pain."
mem/0110/95/p40: Thoth, who rarely cooks, brought me boiled rice and a thick, egg-droplet mixture.
mem/0110/95/p42: "Don't complain. Be grateful for my perfect care."
mem/0110/95/p45: The egg mixture had a faint salty taste when I ate it, and it felt comforting.
mem/0110/95/p46: Maybe it was because Thoth's feelings had melted away?
mem/0110/95/p48: After eating, I started feeling... sleepy... so sleepy...
mem/0110/95/p51: As I closed my eyes, Anubis's large, soft hands gently stroked my head.
mem/0110/95/p52: "...This time is a special exception. You're quite a handful."
mem/0110/95/p54: It was an incredibly, incredibly gentle sound... and it felt so comforting.
mem/0111/96/p1: She sometimes reacts in ways that go beyond what you'd expect from a normal human.
mem/0111/96/p2: It's so interesting that I want to try various things with her.
mem/0111/96/p4: "Today's assignment is to memorize the passages from pages 32 to 45 and complete the writing exercises on page 50. The deadline is tomorrow."
mem/0111/96/p5: The moment he declared this, the god students began complaining and wailing in unison.
mem/0111/96/p6: "Eh, is that really true? Are you serious?"
mem/0111/96/p7: Of course, the amount assigned isn't something I expect them to actually complete. The difficulty level is correspondingly high.
mem/0111/96/p8: "There's no way we can do that much. Ugh, what a pain."
mem/0111/96/p9: "Then~ should I use a trick to get out of it? *"
mem/0111/96/p10: "...It's already been seen through. ...It's pointless to say that in front of Mr. Thoth."
mem/0111/96/p11: The gods, who aren't good at learning, already looked like they had given up.
mem/0111/96/p12: "Yeah, it does seem impossible~. I feel like I'm going to get sick tomorrow, so maybe I should just skip it~"
mem/0111/96/p13: Others, meanwhile, began coming up with excuses.
mem/0111/96/p14: "Dionysus Tyrsos, that doesn't solve anything. Do what you can. If it is your duty."
mem/0111/96/p15: "Well, I suppose I have no choice."
mem/0111/96/p16: "How about we all work together? I feel like I'd give up if I did it alone."
mem/0111/96/p17: Some of them seemed motivated, but it was doubtful they could actually pull it off.
mem/0111/96/p18: By observing their reactions like this, I was trying to gauge each of their personalities... but...
mem/0111/96/p20: Among them, there was one who responded in that manner. It was Kusanagi.
mem/0111/96/p21: She didn't put on a brave face or boast; she simply acknowledged the task.
mem/0111/96/p22: It looked simple at first glance, but accepting such an unreasonable challenge was far from easy. Moreover, her tone sounded surprisingly positive.
mem/0111/96/p23: "If you can do it, then try. Dismissed."
mem/0111/96/p24: Now, the interesting part will be seeing if those words come true.
mem/0111/96/p25: Well, it's obvious that 'we couldn't do it' is the outcome.
mem/0111/96/p26: The next day, as expected, none of the motivated gods managed to complete the assignment... but...
mem/0111/96/p27: "You've managed both the recitation and the spelling."
mem/0111/96/p29: "Yes! I thought it was only natural for a student to do her homework."
mem/0111/96/p30: Her reply was energetic, but she looked as if she had pulled an all-nighter. Her complexion was slightly off.
mem/0111/96/p31: "However, didn't you push yourself too hard?"
mem/0111/96/p32: "Yes... It didn't progress very well, so it took quite a bit of time, but I'm glad it's over. I wish I could have been a bit more efficient."
mem/0111/96/p33: Just getting it done was worth evaluating, but aiming for greater efficiency shows she has high aspirations.
mem/0111/96/p34: There are humans who exceed my expectations. There are humans worth watching.
mem/0111/96/p35: For someone who usually has no interest in others, I find myself this intrigued. Perhaps she is not an ordinary human.
mem/0111/96/p36: What experiment should I conduct next?
mem/0111/96/p37: I was there, and I did not mind thinking that way.
mem/0112/97/p0: What was my school life up until now?
mem/0112/97/p1: Zeus suddenly decided to shut down the academy.
mem/0112/97/p2: True, when I first arrived here, all I could think about was how much I wanted to go home.
mem/0112/97/p3: I had been desperately trying to explain what it means to be human to the gods so I could return to my world, but somewhere along the line, I had started enjoying being with everyone and no longer felt it was my mission.
mem/0112/97/p4: I realized that the other gods felt the same way.
mem/0112/97/p5: "Ah, damn it! What is this? There's still time left until graduation!"
mem/0112/97/p6: Takeru-san struck the classroom desk with his fist in frustration.
mem/0112/97/p7: "Totsuka Takeru, you will injure your hand. Venting your anger will not solve the problem."
mem/0112/97/p9: It was overwhelming. I could feel that emotion.
mem/0112/97/p10: "That's right. We still have so many things left undone. Since we were able to meet like this, I don't want our relationship to end due to such irrationality."
mem/0112/97/p11: Even Balder, who usually wears a gentle and kind smile, was looking down with a pained expression.
mem/0112/97/p12: "This is seriously annoying... I hate orders like this. Why do they completely ignore our opinions?"
mem/0112/97/p13: "But since Zeus is being so stubborn, we might not be able to overturn this."
mem/0112/97/p17: "That's right! We can't just let Zeus do whatever he wants! We can't!"
mem/0112/97/p18: Listening to Apollon's indignant voice, I began to feel lost and unsure of what to do.
mem/0112/97/p19: Zeus's orders are absolute in this Garden, yet I don't want to be separated from everyone.
mem/0112/97/p20: "What will happen to us from now on..."
mem/0112/97/p21: Weak words slipped from my mouth without meaning to.
mem/0112/97/p22: I didn't want to say it, but I couldn't hold it back.
